tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i cho ga rjes gnang dang bcas khrigs su bsdebs pa grub gnyis 'dod rgu'i char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs//

na moḥbadz+ra wa ra h+yai/ bris pas mig la bdud rtsi'i char chen po// 'dra 'bag goms las thun mong sngags grub cing*// byin rlabs zhugs pas 'tshang rgyar bslu med pa// yi dam lha tshogs rgya mtsho'i zhabs la 'dud// rnam mang paṇa grub rnams kyis ngal mdzad gzhung*// rnam grol bde ba'i byed po pusta ka /rnam dag 'jigs med phrag pa'i phyogs 'chang ba// rnam kun 'dzin la bdag 'bad ut+pal skyes// de yang sgrub pa'i thabs rgya mtshor grags pa'i glegs bam rang du cung zad sgrub pa'i tshul mi 'dra ba bshad kyang*/ bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyas btab pa'o zhes brgyud pa'i rim pas cho ga 'gros gcig tu 'chad pa las/ 'dir kun mkhyen pad+ma dkar pos mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i cho ga 'di nyid kyi sgo nas gzhan la phan 'dogs par 'dod pa rnams lag tu blang bde'i ched khrigs bsdebs su dgod pa la/ 1 'phags pa dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i rgyal po gtso bor bsgrub par 'dod pas/ gong du spyi dang bye brag gi sku gsung thugs rten bzhugs su gsol/ de'i mdun du stegs bu khebs ldan la maṇ+ḍal khar lha'i sku mdog dang mtshungs pa'i tshom bu dang*/ bum pa/ mchod gtor/ mdun bum gyi mchod pa rnams brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes bzhin tshar du dngar bar bsham/ rang gi mdun du rdor dril sogs kyang 'du byas nas bde ba'i stan la 'khod de/ thog mar ma nam bzhi skor lan gsum dang*/ thabs mkhas thugs rje sogs bla ma brgyud pa'i bstod tshogs ji ltar 'os pa sngon du btang nas/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyis khrus byas rjes/ dus 'di nas bzung ste snying po byang chub la mchis kyi bar du phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad gcig tu 'dus pa'i ngo bo/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung khungs/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag

rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// sangs rgyas la skyabs= chos la= dge 'dun la= bcom ldan 'das dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes lan gsum dang*/ sangs rgyas chos dang sogs lan gsum/ de nas/ skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes tshogs zhing yid kyis spyan drangs/ de la dmigs te/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi// rang gzhan don gnyis rab bsgrub phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas// sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog/ ces lan gsum gyis skyabs sems byas mthar/ badz+ra muḥ tshogs zhing rnams rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ ces brjod/ de nas/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi bral bar gyur cig bde sdug gi rgyu chags sdang nye ring dang bral ba'i btang snyoms chen po la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig ces tshad med bzhi lan gsum bsgom/ de nas bdag bskyed ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥ swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ gis/ bdag med pa'i rang bzhin gyi stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las maṃ ljang khu las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla gdan gyi steng du/ traṃ las bcom ldan dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i rgyal po sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu/

mtshan dpes mdzes pa shin tu zhi zhing chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ chos gos rnam pa gsum gsol te rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ g.yas su sems dpa' rdo rje 'dzin dkar po phyag gnyis rdo rje bzung ste snying gar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yon du rdo rje 'dzin chen po ser po g.yas nor bu/ mchan khung g.yon du dung*/ mdun gyi g.yas g.yon du khye'u mtha' yas sngon po khro ba ral gri dang ut+pal/ sbrul gyi mchod phyir thogs can dang*/ bu mo mtha' yas ma ljang khu shin tu zhi ba g.yas thal mo dang g.yon pad+ma 'dzin pa/ bzhi ka'ang rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ de rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying ga'i cha stod du hūm̐ sngon po/ cha smad du zla ba la rang rang gi sa bon gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bur 'phros pas ye shes pa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par gyur/ slar yang dbang gi lha tshogs spyan drangs/ de rnams kyis rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsis gang bas mngon par dbang bskur/ lus gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma gyen du 'khyil ba las rigs kyi bdag pos mi bskyod pa'o dbu brgyan par gyur/ snying gar zla ba la sa bon/ de'i mthar sngags kyi 'phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer spro bsdus don gnyis byas par bsams te/ sngags ni/ na maḥs+t+rai ya dhi kā naṃ/ ta thā ga ta naṃ/ sarba tru pra ti ha ta bsti dharma ta ba li naṃ/ oṃ āḥs ma sa ma sa man+ta to/ nan+ta khāsti shā sa ni/ ha ra ha ra/ sma ra sma ra/ bi ga ta ra ga bud+dha dharma te/ sa ra sa ra sa ma bā la/ ha sa ha sa/ tra ya tra ya/ bha ga wān ma hā ba ra la ba ṇe/ dz+wa la dz+wa la na pra ga re swā hā/ zhes de bzhin gshegs pa'i yi ge brgya pa bzla'o// mdun bskyed ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ tshom bu mi dmigs te stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las/ maṃ ljang khu las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla gdan gyi steng du/ traṃ las bcom ldan 'das dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i rgyal po

sogs nas/ rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan par gyur/ ces pa'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin byas la/ de la kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin gyis mchod par mos te/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ pā d+yaṃ/ añtsa ma naṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ srid dang ngan 'gros dub rnams la// bde dang phun tshogs kun 'byung ba// yid bzhin nor ltar rmad byung ba'i// dam tshig gsum rgyal la phyag 'tshal// zhes bstod/ bdag gi thugs ka'i 'od kyis mdun bskyed kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i thugs srog sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer spro bsdus don gnyis byas par bsam ste sngags bzla'o// bum bskyed ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ bum pa mi dmigs te stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i las/ bh+rūṃ las bum pa yangs par bdud rtsi rgya mtsho'i dbus su/ maṃ ljang khu las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla gdan gyi steng du/ trāṃ las bcom ldan 'das dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i rgyal po sogs nas/ dbu brgyan par gyur/ ces pa'i bar dang*/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha swā hā/ sogs kyis gong bzhin mchod cing*/ srid dang ngan 'gros dub rnams la// sogs sh+lau kas bstod/ bdag gis thugs kyi 'od kyis bum lha'i thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i 'od zer gyis don gnyis byas te slar thugs kar thim pas/ bum lha'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ ces brjod nas sngags bzla/ mthar bum lha 'od du zhu nas bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsam mo// de nas gtor bsngos ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ gtor rdzas rnams mi dmigs te stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las/ gtor snod rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ gtor ma zag pa med pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi rgya mtsho chen por zhu bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/

oṃ a ka ro sogs lan gsum gyis phul te/ nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// sogs nas/ las dngamachog gi dngos grub stsol// ces pa'i bar gyis 'dod don gsol/ de nas ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang blangs nas rjes gnang la 'jug par bya/ sgrub thabs mang po sbrel nas mdzad dus/ tshogs zhing thog ma'i de rang gis 'thus pas rjes ma rnams la bya mi dgos/ bdag bskyed ni/ snga ma de kho nas 'thus par mdzad srol yang snang mod/ phyogs 'di'i phyag bzhes la/ lha snga ma de gnas 'gyur nas phyi mar bskyed pa'i tshul gyis bdag bskyed bzlas pa'i bar byas rjes/ de nas mdun bskyed/ bum bskyed/ gtor 'bul rnams rim pa bzhin bya ba ste/ lha ji tsam khyon gcig tu gnang ba'i mjug ma de'i gtor 'bul dbang blangs ba bcas grub nas rjes gnang gi rim pa la 'jug par mdzad do// 2 rdo rje gdan gyi gtso 'khor gsum pa'i sgrub thabs 'di'ang cho ga'i 'gros dam tshig gsum bkod pa bzhin la khyad par ni 'di lta ste/ stong pa'i ngang las zla ba la yi ge hūm̐ ā li kā lis bskor ba dkar po/ de yongs su gyur pa las zla ba hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de rdo rje ser po hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gdan sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu mtshan dpes mdzes pa shin tu zhi zhing bdud 'dul ba'i phyag rgya mdzad pa/ chos gos rnam pa gsum gsol te rdo rje skyil krung gis bdud bzhi brtsegs pa'i khri dang pad zla la bzhugs pa/ g.yas su byams pa ser mdog rnga yab dang klu shing*/ g.yon du spyan ras gzigs dkar po rnga yab dang pad+ma bsnams pa/ gnyis ka sems dpa'i cha byad can rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ spyan/ snyan/ shangs/ ljags/ dpral ba dang nu mar zla ba la rim pa bzhin/ k+ṣiṃ yig dkar po/ dzaṃ sngon po/ khaṃ ser po/ gaṃ dmar po/ kaṃ ser po/ paṃ dkar po/ spyi bor oṃ dkar po man chad sngar bzhin la/ rigs bdag mi bskyod pa'o// sngags ni/

oṃ āḥbadz+ra hūm̐ phaṭ/ bstod pa'i rkang pa mtha' ma'i tshig/ rdo rje gdan la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bsgyur kha bya/ 'dis lhag ma kun kyang rigs 'gre shes par bya'o// 3 yi ge drug pa'i rig pa chen po'i gtso 'khor gsum gyi sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma a las zla ba'i gdan la hrīḥdakar po yongs su gyur pa'i gcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug bsil zer byed pa'i snying po lta bu/ zhal gcig zhi zhing 'dzum pa/ ral pa'i zur phud 'od dpag tu med pas brgyan cing*/ phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis thal mo sbyar ba rgyal ba'i dbang po kun gyi phyag rgya thugs kar gnas pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyi g.yas bgrang phreng dang g.yon chu skyes kyi sdong bu 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing mdzes sdug gi dpyid dar gyi na bzas klubs pa/ kun+da 'bar ba lta bu'i 'od zer gyi khongs na rdo rje skyil mo krung gis pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs pa'i g.yas logs su/ 'phags pa nor bu 'dzin pa ser mdog ral pa dang cod pan can gos ser po gyon pa/ rtsa ba'i phyag thal mo sbyar zhing*/ g.yas nor bu dang g.yon chu skyes 'dzin pa/ g.yon logs su 'phags ma yi ge drug ma dkar mo rtsa phyag thal mo sbyar zhing*/ g.yas bgrang phreng g.yon chu skyes 'dzin pa/ dbang po'i gzhu'i gos can/ gnyis ka'ang gzhon nu'i lang tsho la gnas shing zur phud gcig pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan te sgeg pa dang bcas pa'i skyil krung phyed pas pad+ma la bzhugs par gyur/ spyi bor oṃ man sngar bzhin la/ rigs bdag 'od dpag tu med pa'o// sngags ni/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ zhes bzla bar bya'o// 4 za ma tog bkod pa'i man ngag gi yi ge drug pa gtso rkyang gi sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i gdan la hrīḥdakar po yongs su gyur pa'i bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug bsil zer byed pa'i snying po lta bu/

zhal gcig zhi zhing 'dzum pa/ ral pa'i zur phud 'od dpag tu med pas brgyan cing*/ phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis thal mo sbyar ba rgyal ba'i dbang po kun gyi phyag rgya thugs kar gnas pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyi g.yas bgrang 'phreng dang g.yon chu skyes kyi sdong bu'i khar nor bu 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing*/ mdzes sdug gi dpyid dar gyi nam bzas klubs shing stag lpags kyi sham thabs mnabs pa/ kun+da 'bar ba lta bu'i 'od zer gyi khongs na rdo rje skyil mo krung gis pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ spyi bor oṃ sogs/ rigs bdag snang mtha'o// sngags ni/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ zhes bzla'o// 5 'jig rten mgon po'i sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i gdan la hrīḥdakar po yongs su gyur pa'i bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug sku mdog bsil zer byed pa'i snying po lta bu/ zhal gcig zhi zhing 'dzum pa/ ral pa'i zur phud 'od dpag tu med pas rgyan cing*/ phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis mchog sbyin dang pad+ma/ lhag ma gnyis khu tshur bcings nas gung mo gnyis pad+ma kha 'byed pa lta bu/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing mdzes sdug gi dpyid dar gyi na bzas klubs pa/ kun+da 'bar ba lta bu'i 'od zer gyi khongs na rdo rje skyil mo krung gis pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ spyi bor oṃ sogs/ rigs bdag snang mtha'o// sngags ni/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ zhes bzla'o// 6 khar+sa pa ṇa gtso 'khor lnga pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma a las zla ba/ de'i steng du hrīḥyis mtshan pa las bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug mkha' la spyod pa'i mgon po bsil zer byed pa'i snying po lta bu/ zhal gcig zhi zhing 'dzum pa/ ral pa'i zur phud 'od dpag tu med pas brgyan cing*/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya las bdud rtsi 'dzag pas/

yi dwags kyi tshogs tshim par mdzad pa/ g.yon chu skyes kyi sdong bu'i rtsa ba mtheb srin sbyar bas thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mdzes sdug gi dpyid dar gyi na bzas klubs pa/ kun+da 'bar ba lta bu'i 'od zer gyi khongs na skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs shing*/ mdun na sgrol ma ljang sngon mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang ut+pal ljang khu'i sdong bu bzung ste phyed skyil gyis bzhugs pa/ g.yas su gzhon nu nor bzang gser mdog can/ g.yas thal mo g.yon po ti 'dzin pa/ g.yon na khro gnyer can ser mo ral pa'i tshogs dang ldan pa/ g.yas phyag 'tshal ba'i tshul dang bgrang 'phreng*/ g.yon rtse gsum dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ rgyab tu rta mgrin dmar po thung zhing lto ba 'phyang ba khro bo'i bzhin/ stag sham can/ sbrul gyis brgyan cing dbyug pa bsnams pa/ spyi bor oṃ sogs/ rigs bdag 'od dpag med do// sngags ni/ oṃ hrīḥswā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 7 'jig rten mgon po khar+sa pa ṇa gtso 'khor gsum pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla la hrīḥlas 'jig rten mgon po zla ba'i 'od zer lta bu rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ ral pa'i cod pan can/ mchog sbyin dang chu skyes 'dzin pa rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ g.yas su sgrol ma dang*/ g.yon du rta mgrin/ spyi bor oṃ

sogs/ rigs bdag 'od dpag med do// sngags ni/ oṃ hrīḥswā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 8 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla la laṃ yongs su gyur pa las 'jig rten dbang phyug zla ba'i 'od zer lta bu rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ ral pa'i cod pan can/ mchog sbyin dang chu skyes 'dzin pa/ skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ spyi bor oṃ sogs/ rigs bdag snang mtha'o// sngags ni/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ zhes bzla'o// 9 spyan ras gzigs seṅge sgra'i sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma/ oṃ las zla ba/ a dkar po las seṅge dkar mo'i steng du/ paṃ las pad dkar ze'u 'brur hrīḥdakar po rnams yongs su gyur pa las rje btsun seṅge sgra zla shel gyi mdangs can/ phyag g.yon sar btsugs shing g.yas chos 'chad/ dka' thub pa'i cha lugs 'dzin pa/ stag sham can/ rgyal po rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i g.yas kyi phyag na sbrul dkar pos dkris pa'i rtse gsum dkar po/ g.yon sar btsugs pas rtsa ba bzung ba'i pad+ma langs pa'i steng na 'bar ba'i ral gri 'phyar ba'i mdun du me tog gis gang ba'i thod pa dkar po/ ral pa'i zur phud 'od dpag med kyis rgyan te 'od zer gyi pa tra'i khongs na de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprin rnam par 'phro ba/ spyi bor oṃ sogs/ rigs bdag 'od dpag med do// sngags ni/ oṃ āḥhrīḥsidha nā da hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces bzla'o// 10 'jig rten dbang phyug ha la ha la rdo rje chos kyi sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla la hrīḥlas 'jig rten dbang phyug ha la ha la chen po sku mdog dkar po/ dkar sngo dmar ba'i zhal re re'ang spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag drug gi g.yas mchog sbyin/ bgrang 'phreng*/ mda'/ g.yon mas rim gyis gzhu/ pad dkar/ yum gyi nu ma 'dzin pa/ brla g.yon pa'i steng du lha mo sgeg ma g.yas pa bcom ldan 'das la 'khyud cing g.yon chu skyes/

g.yas logs su sbrul gyis dkris pa'i rtse gsum/ g.yon logs na pad+ma la gnas pa'i me tog dri zhim po sna tshogs pas gang ba'i thod pa bsnams pa sgeg pa'i nyams can/ zla phyed 'dzin pa'i zur phud thod 'phreng gis spras pa/ ral pa'i dbus na 'od dpag med dang*/ rgyan gyis brgyan pa stag sham can/ pad+ma dang zla ba la rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ spyi bor oṃ sogs/ rigs bdag 'od dpag med do// sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra dharma hrīḥ snying po gnyis pa/ oṃ ha la ha la hrīḥ zhes bzla'o// 11 pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla la hrīḥdamar po las pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yon gyis pad dmar/ g.yas pas de kha 'byed pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing*/ 'od dpag med pa'i cod pan can/ g.yon phyogs nas gos dkar mos 'khyud de sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ shar du rnam gzigs ma dkar mo pad dmar/ lhor sgrol ma ljang khu pad ljang*/ nub tu dbang phyug ma ser mo 'khor lo ut+pal/ byang du khro gnyer can dkar mo pad ser/ mer pad+ma'i gdan can ma pad dmar/ bden bral du rdo rje pad+ma sngon mo pad dkar/ rlung du sna tshogs pad+ma dkar mo pad nag dbang ldan du sna tshogs rdo rje ma sna tshogs mdog can/ sna tshogs pad ma thams cad zhal gcig zhi ba rgyan gyis spras te sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ spyi bor oṃ sogs/ rigs bdag 'od dpag med do// sngags ni/ oṃ hrīḥpad+ma nri ti shwa ra hūm̐/ zhes bzla'o// 12 pad+ma gar dbang phyag mang gi sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i steng du hrīḥdakar po yongs su gyur pa las pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dkar po/ zhal gcig phyag bco brgyad/ phyag thams cad kyis sna tshogs pad+ma bsnams pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ rim pa dang por sgrol ma/ nor bzang*/ khro gnyer can/

sogs/ rigs bdag 'od dpag med do// sngags ni/ oṃ hrīḥtrai lo kya bi dza ya a mo gha pā sha pra ti ha ta hrīḥha hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 22 yang don zhags phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ mtsho dang rin po che'i rir pad+ma dang byang chub kyi sems zhu ba ā li kā li las zla nyi kha sbyar gyi dbus su/ hrīḥdakar po las skyes pa'i pad+ma/ de las 'od zer 'phros don gnyis byas tshur 'dus pa las/ ze'u 'brur ldan pa rnams gcig tu gyur pa ye shes lnga'i rim pas/ bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug don yod zhags pa sku mdog dkar po zhi ba'i sku/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas mchog sbyin dang zhags pa/ g.yon pad+ma dmar po dang rtse gsum/ ral pa'i cod pan la 'od dpag med bzhugs shing mchod phyir thogs dkar pos brgyan pa/ rin po che'i ri'i phug na sna tshogs pa'i pad zla la mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ de'i mdun du pad zla la ha dmar po las lcags kyu/ de las don yod lcags kyu skya rengs kyi mdog can/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas lcags kyu dang rdo rje/ g.yon zhags pa dang pad+ma/ rgyan dmar pos brgyan cing rgya nag gi gos dang ral pa'i cod pan can/ g.yas su pad nyi la hūm̐ dmar po las pad+mas mtshan pa'i dbyug pa dkar po las rta mgrin bskal pa'i me dang nyi ma 'bar ba lta bu/ rtsa zhal 'jigs pa hūm̐ gi sgra sgrog pa/ steng na rta zhal ljang khu/ thung zhing gsus pa che ba/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas dbyug pa dang rdo rje/ g.yon sdigs mdzub dang pad+ma/ sbrul gyis brgyan cing stag sham can/ rgyab tu ha sngon po las ral gri/ de las ral gcig ma ral pa dmar ser gcig tu 'khyil ba/ khro mo spyan gsum pa/ glang lpags kyis stod g.yogs shing stag sham can sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas ral gri dang gri gug g.yon ut+pal dang thod pa/ g.yon du pad zla la ḍa ser po las pad+ma/ de las khro gnyer can ser mo dar la babs pa'i gzugs dar dkar gyi na bza' dang lha'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/

phyag bzhi'i g.yas na pad+ma dang 'phreng ba/ g.yon na dbyug gu dang spyi blugs bsnams pa/ spyi bor oṃ sogs/ rigs bdag snang mtha'o// sngags ni/ oṃ hrīḥtrai lo kya bi dza ya a mo gha pā shā pra ti ha ta hrīḥha hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 23 'jig rten gsum dbang du byed pa 'phags pa bhug+ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ hrīḥganyis las zla nyi kha sbyar gyi dbus su/ hrīḥlas pad+ma dmar po hrīḥyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas tshur 'dus pa thams cad yongs su gyur pa'i 'phags pa bhug+ma dbang phyug ma byi ru'i ri bo lta bu/ zhal gcig zhi zhing mdzes pa/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon pad+ma/ lha rdzas kyi rgyan dang gos 'dzin pa/ mnyam pa'i stabs kyis pad zla la bzhugs pa/ phyogs kyi pad 'dab dmar po la zla ba bzhi/ mtshams su laṃ māṃ paṃ tāṃ las zla nyi kha sbyor gyi dbus su/ sa bon de dag gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa mer spyan ma dkar mo/ bden bral du mā ma ki sngon mo/ rlung du gos dkar mo dmar mo/ dbang ldan du sgrol ma gser mdog thams cad pus mo sa la btsugs shing thal mo sbyar ba/ lha'i bu mo lo bcu drug ma'i mdzes sdug gi dpal thams cad dang rgyan gos kyis spras pa/ sogs gong bzhin/ rigs bdag 'od dpag med do// sngags ni/ oṃ āḥhrīḥhūm̐/ zhes bzla'o// 24 'jam dpal brtan pa'i 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las muṃ dmar ser gnyis steng nas steng du brtsegs pa gnyis yongs su gyur pa las/ zla ba dmar po dbyangs dang gsal byed kyi mtshan pa gnyis kha sbyar ba'i steng du/ ut+pa la'i ze'u 'bru sa bon des mtshan pa rnams gcig tu 'dres pa las/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mdog gser gyi mdog lta bu rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ ral gri dang*/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i po tis mtshan pa'i ut+pa la'i sdong bu 'dzin pa'i phyag gnyis bshad pa'i phyag rgya mdzad cing*/

zur phud lnga pa mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can gzhon nu'i brtul zhugs 'dzin pa/ sgeg cing 'dzum la zhi ba skyil krung phyed pa'i tshul gyis pad zla la bzhugs pa/ thugs kar mūṃ yig las skyes pa'i brtan pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa 'od dmar po 'phro ba/ lte ba dang shar nas g.yas bskor gyis/ phyogs kyi rtsibs la a ra pa tsa na/ me la sogs pa'i mtshams bzhi la/ ni pra pañtsa/ lte ba'i mu khyud la ā li/ phyi'i mu khyud la kā li'i 'phreng ba rnams dmar ser/ de'i 'od zer gyis lus thams cad gang nas ba spu rnams las byung ste don gnyis byas/ slar de dag nas zhugs pa= rigs bdag mi bskyod pa'o// sngags ni/ oṃ a ra pa tsa na muṃḥ zhes bzla'o// 25 'phags pa 'jam dpal smra ba'i seṅge'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad zla'i steng du maṃ las 'od zer 'phros don gnyis byas slar 'dus pa las/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mdog gser gyi mdog lta bu rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ phyag gnyis bshad pa'i phyag rgya mdzad pa'i g.yon na ut+pal bsnams shing seṅge sngon po'i gdan la phyed skyil gyis bzhugs pa/ mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ g.yas su suṃ las gzhon nu nor bzang rgyan gyis mdzes pa/ chos thams cad kyi po ti gcig mchan na bzung nas thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yon logs na hūm̐ las gshin rje gshed nag po khro bo shin tu 'jigs pa/ phyag na tho ba bsnams pa sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ de gnyis kyi snam logs su zla ba'i 'od dang nyi ma'i 'od/ phyogs bzhir rnam snang*/ rin 'byung*/ 'od dpag med/ don yod grub pa/ mtshams bzhir spyan ma/ mā ma ki gos dkar mo/ sgrol ma rnams bzhugs shing= rigs bdag mi bskyod pa'o// sngags ni/ oṃ dharmaḥdhā tu wā gi shwa ri muṃ swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 26 'jam dpal ngag gi rgyal po'am shes rab 'phel ba'i gter gyi sgrub thabs ni/ sna tshogs pad zla'i steng du thiṃlha dmar po las de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'gugs pa'i 'od zer spros te de nyid la thim pa las/

ut+pa la'i dbus su zla ba la gnas pa'i sa bon/ de'i 'od zer gyis 'gro ba thams cad 'jam dpal ngag gi rgyal por bsgrubs te/ slar de nyid la zhugs pa yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mdog gser gyi mdog lta bu rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ phyag gnyis bshad pa'i phyag rgya mdzad pa'i g.yon na ut+pal bsnams shing seṅge sngon po'i gdan la phyed skyil gyis bzhugs pa/ mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can= rigs bdag bshad ma thag pa de'o// sngags ni/ thiṃlha/ zhes pa'i sa bon de ka'o// 27 'jam pa'i dbyangs rgyal po chen po rol pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ muṃ dmar ser las/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mdog gser lta bu/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yon ut+pal sngon po bsnams pa/ g.yas chos 'chad/ rol pa'i stabs kyis seṅge'i gdan la bzhugs pa= rigs bdag mi bskyod pa'o// sngags ni/ oṃ wa gi shwa ri muṃ/ zhes bzla'o// 28 'jam dpal ngag gi rgyal po gtso 'khor gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ snying khar a las zla ba la muṃḥdamar ser/ de'i 'od kyi sems can gyi don mdzad/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams bsdus te thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i dbyangs gser gyi mdog lta bu rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ chos kyi 'khor lo'i phyag rgya can gyi g.yas pa'i phyag gis ut+pa la'i rtsa ba bzung ba'i rtser sher phyin gyi po ti/ skyil krung phyed pas seṅge'i steng du pad zla la bzhugs pa/ zhabs g.yon pa'i ngar gdong la brten pa'i khro bo chen po gshin rje gshed nag po/ phyag g.yas bcom ldan 'das kyi rje ngar la reg cing*/ g.yon dbyug pa bsnams pa= rigs bdag mi bskyod pa'o/ sngags ni/ oṃ dharma dhā tu wā gi shwa ri muṃḥ zhes bzla'o// 29 'jam dpal ngag gi rgyal po gtso 'khor gsum pa'i sgrub thabs ni/

snying khar a las zla ba la muṃḥdamar ser/ de'i 'od kyis sems can gyi don mdzad/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams bsdus te thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i dbyangs gser gyi mdog lta bu rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ chos kyi 'khor lo'i phyag rgya can gyi g.yon pa'i phyag gis ut+pa la'i rtsa ba nas bzung ba'i rtser sher phyin gyi po ti skyil krung phyed pas seṅge'i steng du pad zla la bzhugs pa/ zhabs g.yon pa'i ngar gdong la brten pa'i khro bo chen po gshin rje gshed nag po/ phyag g.yas bcom ldan 'das kyi rje ngar la reg cing*/ g.yon dbyug pa bsnams pa/ g.yas na gzhon nu nor bzang rgyan gyis mdzes pa chos thams cad kyi po ti gcig mchan na bzung nas thal mo sbyar ba= rigs bdag mi bskyod pa'o// sngags ni/ oṃ wā gi shwa ri muṃḥ zhes bzla'o// 30 'jam dpal gyi rtogs pa las gsungs pa'i ngag gi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs ni/ rang gi snying gar hūm̐ dmar po 'od 'bar ba las nyi ma/ de'i steng du zla ba dmar po/ de la yi ge maṃ kha dog lnga dang ldan pa yongs su gyur pa'i bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i dbyangs gser gyi mdog lta bu/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ chos kyis 'khor lo'i phyag rgya can gyi g.yas pa'i phyag gis ut+pa la'i rtsa ba nas bzung ba'i rtser sher phyin gyi po ti/ skyil krung phyed pas seṅge'i steng du pad zla la bzhugs pa= rigs bdag mi bskyod pa'o// sngags ni/ oṃ mañdzu badz+ra hūm̐/ zhes bzla'o// 31 a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs ni/ snying gar a las zla ba la dhīḥ de yongs su gyur pa las ral gri sa bon gyis mtshan pa/ de las de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo nyid/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i dbyangs ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba/ pad+ma rgyas pa'i zhal can bcu drug lon pa'i lang tsho/

phyag g.yas na mi shes pa ma lus pa gcod pa'i ral gri/ g.yon na thabs su gyur pa ma lus pa'i bstan bcos kyi po ti bsnams pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing na bza' dmar po/ zur phud lnga pa'i cod pan can/ rdo rje skyil krung gis pad dkar dang zla ba la bzhugs pa/ thugs kar a las skyes pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i 'od zer gyis mi shes pa'i mun pa 'joms pa/ de'i mdun gyi nam mkhar yang 'khor lo de lta bur 'khor ba'i mdun du ra las dra ba can gyi 'od rgyab tu pa las zla 'od gnyis mchog sbyin dang pad+ma/ g.yas su tsa las sgra can ma/ g.yon du na las nye ba'i sgra can ma mchog sbyin dang ut+pal/ thams cad dkar po lang tsho la gnas pa/ rang gi sa bon gyis snying ga mdzes pa= rigs bdag mi bskyod pa'o// sngags ni/ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥ zhes bzla'o// 32 a ra pa tsa na dmar po'i sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla la dhīḥyongs su gyur pa las ral gri sa bon gyis mtshan pa/ de las de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo nyid/ dbus su bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mdog dmar po pad+ma rgyas pa'i zhal can/ bcu drug lon pa'i lang tsho/ phyag g.yas na mi shes pa ma lus pa gcod pa'i ral gri/ g.yon na thabs su gyur pa ma lus pa'i bstan bcos kyi po ti bsnams pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing na bza' dmar po/ zur phud lnga pa'i cod pan can/ rdo rje skyil krung gis pad dkar dang zla ba la bzhugs pa/ thugs kar a las skyes pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i 'od zer gyis mi shes pa'i mun pa 'joms pa/ mdun du ra las dra ba can gyi 'od ljang khu phyag g.yon pad+ma dang g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yas su pa yig las sgra can sku mdog ser mo mchog sbyin dang pad+ma dmar po bsnams pa/ rgyab tu tsa yig las zla 'od sku mdog zla ba lta bu mchog sbyin dang pad+ma'i phyag rgya can/ g.yon du na yig las nye ba'i sgra can ma sku mdog dmar mo ut+pal dang mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya can/

mdun gyi nam mkhar me'i 'od kyi 'khor lo 'khor bzhin pa dang*/ de'i steng du zla ba dang*/ de'i steng du 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa/ 'khor lo'i bar du sngags hram me ba= rigs bdag mi bskyod pa'o// sngags ni/ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥ zhes bzla'o// 33 'jam dpal yan lag med pa'i rdo rje'i sgrub thabs ni/ sna tshogs pad nyi'i gdan la baṃ ser po yongs su gyur pa'i 'jam dpal yan lag med pa'i rdo rje sku mdog ser po bcu drug pa'i lang tsho dang ral pa'i cod pan can/ zhal gcig phyag drug gi rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis ut+pal dmar po'i mde'u dang bcas pa'i mda'/ me tog gi gzhu dang sbyar te 'gengs pa/ lhag ma'i g.yas ral gri/ me long*/ g.yon na ut+pal dang*/ mya ngan med pa'i me tog rgyan thams cad dang na bza'/ mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ sgeg pa dang bcas pas zhabs g.yon brkyang ba= rigs bdag mi bskyod pa'o// sngags ni/ oṃ mañdzu gho ṣa hrīḥdzaḥ zhes bzla'o// 34 chos dbyings gsung gi dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs ni/ sna tshogs pad zla'i gdan la a yig dkar po las/ chos dbyings gsung gi dbang phyug sku mdog dkar po zhal bzhi phyag brgyad kyi dang po gnyis chos kyi 'khor lo'i phyag rgya/ lhag ma'i g.yas ral gri/ mda'/ rdo rje/ g.yon po ti/ gzhu/ dril bu/ sangs rgyas lngas dbu brgyan cing lha'i gos dang rgyan/ sgeg pa la sogs pa'i nyams dang ldan pa rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ snying gar zla ba la hūm̐ sngon po las skyes pa'i rdo rje'i phyag rgya chen po/ smin mtshams su traṃ ser po las skyes pa'i rin po che'i chos rgya/ mgrin par hrīḥdamar po las skyes pa'i pad+ma dam rgya/ spyi bor a ljang las skyes pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje las rgya ste phyag rgya bzhi dang ldan pa= rigs bdag rigs lnga'o// sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra tik+ṣa ṇa duḥkha ts+tshe da pra dzñā dzñā na murta ye dzñā na kā ya wā gi shwa ra a ra pa tsa na ya te na maḥ

zhes bzla'o// 35 chos dbyings gsung dbang dmar po'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad zla la hoḥyig dmar po yongs su gyur pa'i chos dbyings gsung gi dbang phyug sku mdog dang zhal bzhi dmar po/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yas pa bzhi mda'/ zhags pa/ sher phyin gyi po ti/ rdo rje/ g.yon pa bzhi gzhu/ lcags kyu/ ral gri/ dril bu/ chags pa chen pos sgeg cing*/ lha'i rgyan gos kyis spras te zur phud la 'od dpag tu med pa gnas pa/ rol pa'i stabs kyis sna tshogs pad zla la bzhugs pa= rigs bdag 'od dpag tu med pa'o// sngags ni/ oṃ ma hā rā ga badz+ra rā ga ya sarba satwaṃ hoḥ zhes bzla'o// 36 chos dbyings gsung dbang phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ zla ba la gnas pa'i aṃ dkar po las bcom ldan 'das chos dbyings gsung dbang zla shel lta bu rdo rje skyil krung gi steng na ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya can/ gzhon nu rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing zur phud lnga dang ldan pa/ thugs kar zla ba dang pad+mar khaṃ las skyes pa'i dung*/ oṃ badz+ra dzi hoḥraṃ las rdo rje'i lce/ de'i steng du rin po che dang pad+ma la 'od dpag med/ rang gi rkan gyi phyogs su bdud rtsi babs bzhin pa'i baṃ yig dkar po mgo thur du bstan pa/ rkan zhur maṃ bdud rtsi 'bab pa=

rigs bdag 'od dpag tu med pa'o// sngags ni/ oṃ wa kye daṃ na ma/ zhes bzla'o// 37 chos dbyings gsung dbang dmar po phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ paṃ las pad mar āḥlas bcom ldan 'das gsung gi dbang phyug li khri lta bu/ rdo rje skyil krung gi steng na ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya can gzhon nu rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing zur phud lnga dang ldan pa/ thugs kar zla ba dang pad mar khaṃ las skyes pa'i dung*/ oṃ badz+ra dzi hoḥ raṃ las rdo rje'i lce/ de'i steng du rin po che dang pad+ma la 'od dpag med/ rang gi rkan gyi phyogs su bdud rtsi babs bzhin pa'i baṃ yig dkar po mgo thur du bstan pa/ rkan zhur maṃ bdud rtsi 'bab pa= rigs bdag 'od dpag tu med pa'o// sngags ni/ oṃ wa kye daṃ na ma/ zhes bzla'o// 38 dpa' bo gcig tu grub pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ snying gar paṃ dkar po las pad+ma'i ze'u 'brur/ ā li bcu drug tshar gnyis mtshan gyi ngo bo las zla ba la oṃ dkar po/ a dar+sha dzñā na swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ de'i steng du kā li so drug yi ge drug dang bcas pa nyis 'gyur dpe byad kyi bdag nyid las zla ba gnyis pa/ sa ma tā dzñā na swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ de'i steng du oṃ yongs su gyur pa las ut+pal sngon po'i ze'u 'brur oṃ dkar pos mtshan pa/ pra t+ya bek+ṣe ṇā dzñā na swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃḥ sa bon las 'od 'phros/ 'gro drug rnams dpa' bo gcig tu grub par sbyangs nas lus la zhugs/ 'jam dpal gyi bde ba la bkod de sa bon la thim/ kṝ t+ya nuṣ+ṭhin dzñā na swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃḥ de yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das dpa' bo gcig tu grub pa 'gro ba rnams 'od kyis snang bar mdzad pa'i zla ba gsar pa lta bu/ zhal gcig lta ba'i mig gi bdud rtsi'i char pa/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon ut+pal thugs kar bsnams pa/ rdo rje skyil krung gis zla ba la bzhugs pa/

thugs kar pad dkar la oṃ las ut+pa la'i zla ba/ de la sa bon/ de las spros pa'i lha mo rnams kyis dpal ldan dpa' bo gcig tu grub pa rgyal bar gyur cig rgyal bar gyur cig ces brjod cing khrus gsol bas/ zur phud la mi bskyod pas brgyan te ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid/ su bi shud+dhā dharmāḥdha tu dzñā na swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ ji srid 'dod kyi bar ro// rigs bdag mi bskyod pa'o// bzlas pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra tik+ṣ+ṇa duḥkhats+tshe da pradzñā dzñā na murta ye dzñā na kā ya wa gi shwa ra a ra pa tsa na ya te na maḥ zhes bzla/ snying po ni/ oṃ wa kye daṃ na ma/ oṃ hrīḥhūm̐/ zhes bzla/ mthar mchod cing bstod de 'di ni bsgom pa 'di kho na'o// 39 ngag gi rdo rje'i sgrub thabs ni/ paṃ las sna tshogs pad+mar a las zla ba la/ hrīḥdamar po las 'od dpag tu med pa sku mdog dmar po rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya mdzad de rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ snying gar zla ba la hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga dbus ra'i rtser a dmar po/ lce bzhi'i rtse mo la hrīḥdamar po= rigs bdag snang mtha'o// sngags ni/ āḥhrīḥ zhes bzla'o// 40 dpal he ru ka 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i sgrub thabs ni/ chu skyes dmar po'i ze'u 'bru la/ skad cig gis dpal dgyes mdzad 'jam pa'i rdo rje dmar po bdag med mas mgul nas 'khyud pa/ zhal brgyad/ phyag bcu drug zhabs bzhis bdud bzhi mnan pa/ phyag rgya sna tshogs pas mdzes pa/ yab kyi snying gar dmar ba'i ut+pal 'dab brgyad kyi ze'u 'brur ā li kā li/ dbus su āḥdang hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de gnyis las 'od zer dmar pos 'jig rten rnams gur gum gyi khu ba lta bur sbyangs te/ 'gro ba rnams kyi lus ngag yid dang lhan cig āḥdang hūm̐ gi thig le la zhugs pas/ de gnyis yongs su gyur pa las bung ba 'khrigs pa'i rin po che ku ru bhin+dha lta bu/

snying rje'i sbrang rtsi 'thung bas myos shing rgyun mi 'chad par grol ba/ hūm̐ zhes ring du sgrag pa/ mdzes pa'i sku bdag med ma dang he ru ka'i rang bzhin skye dgu'i snying le brgan ltar dmar ba/ chu'i thigs pa lta bur shin tu phra ba'i a dang hūm̐ rnams la zhugs nas/ de dag gi lus ngag yid blangs te dbugs rngub hub pa'i bzhon pa las/ rang rang gi snying ga'i ze'u 'bru la zhugs nas mnyam pa nyid du gyur par bsgom mo// rigs bdag rdo rje sems dpa'o// sngags ni/ oṃ hūm̐/ zhes bzla'o// 41 'jam pa'i rdo rje zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ snying gar zla ba la muṃ ser po las 'jam dpal gzhon nu sku mdog dmar ser/ rtsa zhal ser po/ g.yas sngo/ g.yon dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas ral gri/ mda'/ mchog sbyin/ g.yon ut+pal/ gzhu/ po ti/ gzhon nu sgeg cing rgyan dang na bza' mdzes pa sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag rdo rje sems dpa'o// sngags ni/ oṃ muṃḥ zhes bzla'o// 42 rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod las byung ba'i 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs ni/ pad zla la thig le dkar po 'od spro bsdu rlung 'byung rngub dang mthun par byas pa'i nang du/ dhīḥdakar po las 'od 'phros/ ba spu'i khung bu nas thon/ 'gro ba thams cad dhīḥru gyur pa las ral gri sa bon gyis mtshan pa/ de las de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo nyid/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i dbyangs ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba pad+ma rgyas pa'i zhal can/ bcu drug lon pa'i lang tsho/ phyag g.yas na mi shes pa ma lus pa gcod pa'i ral gri dang*/ g.yon na thabs su gyur pa ma lus pa'i bstan bcos kyi po ti bsnams pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing na bza' dmar po/ zur phud lnga'i cod pan can/ rdo rje skyil krung gis pad dkar dang zla ba la bzhugs pa/ snying gar zla ba la dhīḥyis mtshan par

bsam la/ rigs bdag mi bskyod pa'o// sngags ni/ oṃ dhi'aḥswā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 43 mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i shes rab 'khor lo'i dngos grub mchog sgrub pa'i thabs ni/ a las ral gri'i chang zung as mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa'i 'jam dbyangs dkar po phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas ral gri 'phyar zhing g.yon po ti thugs kar 'dzin pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan te sems skyil gyis pad zla la bzhugs pa/ lte ba'i 'og tu bh+rūṃ las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la aṃ/ de yongs su gyur pa las pad+ma kha zum pa/ lte ba'i steng du hūm̐ kha bye ba/ de'i steng du zla ba/ de'i steng du sor gcig spangs par 'khor lo rtsibs drug pa/ rtsibs rnams la dbyangs bcu gnyis kyi gnyis gnyis rtsibs kyi steng du rtsa ba'i ye ge lte bar dhīḥ mu khyud la kā li/ de'i steng du sor gcig spangs par zla ba la a ra pa tsa na 'khod pa shin tu myur bar 'khor bar bsgom mo// rigs bdag rdo rje sems dpa'o// sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra tik+ṣ+ṇa muḥ zhes bzla'o// 44 chos kyi dung gi 'jam dbyangs kyi sgrub thabs ni/ dkyil 'khor gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs dang ldan pa'i nang na sgeg sogs brgyad/ de'i dbus re kha zlum pos bskor ba'i nang na/ 'chi ba 'joms shing chos thams cad gsal bar mdzad pa'i phyir/ maṃ las 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mdog dkar po zhal bzhi phyag brgyad kyi dang po gnyis chos kyi 'khor lo'i phyag rgya/ lhag ma'i g.yas ral gri/ mda'/ rdo rje/ g.yon po ti/ gzhu/ dril bu/ sangs rgyas lngas dbu brgyan cing lha'i gos dang rgyan/ sgeg pa la sogs pa'i nyams dang ldan pa rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ snying gar chos kyi dung yi ge'i rang bzhin thams cad kyis bskor ba las/ thig le dbyangs kyi sgra mgrin pa'i phyogs brgyud lce nas thon/ nam mkha' gang bar dbyangs kyi sgras khyab par bsam mo// rigs bdag mi bskyod pa'o// sngags ni/

oṃ wa kye daṃ na ma/ zhes bzla'o// de ni lho nang gi gsung rgyun ji lta bar bkod pa yin la/ yang dpe la lar 'di ltar byung ste/ dkyil 'khor gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs dang ldan pa'i nang na sgeg sogs brgyad/ de'i dbus re kha zlum pos bskor ba'i nang na/ 'chi ba 'joms shing chos thams cad gsal bar mdzad pa'i phyir/ maṃ las 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mdog dkar po phyag gnyis pa/ rdo rje skyil mo krung gi steng na ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya dang ldan pa gzhon nu rgyan gyis brgyan cing zur phud lnga dang ldan pa/ gsal zhing dri ma med pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin/ oṃ badz+ra dzi hoḥ raṃ zhes pas lce rdo rje'i rang bzhin/ lce steng du rin po che pad+ma la ting nge 'dzin dang ldan pa'i 'od dpag med/ de'i steng du rkan la baṃ yig mgo thur du bstan pa las bdud rtsi babs pa/ snying khar chos kyi dung yi ge'i rang bzhin thams cad kyis bskor ba las thig le dbyangs kyi sgra mgrin pa'i phyogs brgyud lce nas thon te nam mkha' gang bar dbyangs kyi sgras khyab par bsam mo// rigs bdag mi bskyod pa'o// sngags ni/ oṃ wa kye daṃ na ma/ zhes bzla'o// de gnyis gang btsan brtag par bya'o// 45 mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa sa bon dang bcas pa las kun tu 'phros pa'i rdo rje'i rwa gur bzhi dang bcas pa'i lte bar hrīḥlas pad+ma/ a las zla bar dmar la dkar ba'i muṃ yig sangs rgyas dpag tu med pa spro ba dang bsdu ba'i bdag nyid can las/ rje btsun 'jam dpal dmar la dkar ba/ dmar sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis ral gri dang po ti/ gnyis pa gnyis mda' dang gzhu/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i gzhon nu'i sku rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ thugs kar pad zla la sems skyil gyis bzhugs pa'i sems ma rdo rje ma dkar mo/

g.yas snying gar rdo rje 'degs pa dang*/ g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/ smin mtshams su rin chen rdo rje ma ser mo/ phyag gnyis spyi bor me tog gi 'phreng ba bcings pa/ mgrin par pad+ma rdo rje ma dkar dmar/ g.yon pad sdong g.yas pas kha 'byed pa/ spyi bor las kyi rdo rje ma ljang khu rdo rje rtse gsum phyag gnyis kyis spyi bor 'dzin pa= rigs bdag mi bskyod pa'o// sngags ni/ oṃ sarba dharmāḥ.a bhā wa swa bhā wa bi shud+dhaḥbadz+ra a a aṃ aḥpra kṛ ti pa ri shud+dhā sarba dharmā ya tu ta sarba ta thā ga ta dzñā na kā ya mañdzu shrī pa ri shud+dhi ta mu pa ta ye ti a āḥ sarba ta thā ga ta hṝ da ya ha ra ha ra oṃ hūm̐ hrīḥ bha ga wān dzñā na mūrti wā gī shwa ra ma hā pā tsa sarba dharmaḥg ga na a ma la su pa ri shud+dha dharmaḥdhartu dzñā na gar+bha a/ zhes bzla'o// 46 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i sgrub thabs ni/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā āt+ma ko3haṃ/ chos 'byung gi dbus su sna tshogs chu skyes dang*/ rdo rje'i dbus su mchod rten/ de'i nang nu rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams de'i zhal nas zhugs/ byang sems kyi rnam pas rdo rje'i lam nas 'thon pa yi ge gsum gyi rang bzhin las lha mo'i chu skyes na hoḥyig gnyis kyis brgyan pa/ de las byung ba'i 'od zer gyis rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum dang bcas pa 'od du zhu ba zla ba'i khu ba/ phyogs kun na gnas pa'i lha mo rnams kyi glus bskul bas/ dngos po thams cad sgyu ma lta bur gzigs te/ maṃ las 'jam pa'i rdo rje sku mdog dmar ser sngo dkar gnyis dang bcas zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis rang 'od kyi rig ma la 'khyud nas ma mchu zhal gyis 'jib pa/ gnyis pa gnyis ral gri dang mda'/ gsum pa gnyis ut+pal sngon po dang gzhu/ rgyan thams cad kyis mdzes pa rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/

oṃ dharmāḥdha tu swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ mig sogs skye mched drug la k+ṣiṃ dzaṃ khaṃ gaṃ kaṃ paṃ las sems dpa' drug nyi mar bzhugs pa/ gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta wā ka badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ ye shes pa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dbang lhas dbang bskur ba'i chu rgyun mgo bo snying ga lte gsang zhabs la/ oṃ hūm̐ swā aḥha las/ rnam snang*/ mi g.yo/ rin 'byung*/ 'od dpag med/ don grub rnams bzhugs pa/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ mchod pa'i lha mos mchod cing*/ mchog sbyin rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud// yang dag mthar gyur khyod la 'dud// stong nyid snying po khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas byang chub khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas chags pa khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas 'dod la phyag 'tshal 'dud// sangs rgyas dgyes pa khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas rol la phyag 'tshal 'dud// sangs rgyas 'dzum pa khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas bzhad la phyag 'tshal 'dud// sangs rgyas gsung nyid khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas thugs la phyag 'tshal 'dud// med pa las byung khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas 'byung ba khyod la 'dud// nam mkha' las byung khyod la 'dud// ye shes las byung khyod la 'dud// sgyu 'phrul dra ba khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas rol ston khyod la 'dud// thams cad thams cad khyod la 'dud// ye shes sku nyid khyod la 'dud// oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs pa'i bdud rtsi lnga dang sgron ma lnga bza'o// rigs bdag rdo rje sems dpa'o// sngags ni/ oṃ āḥmaṃ hūm̐/ zhes bzla'o// 47 mi g.yo ba sngon po'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad nyi'i gdan la hūm̐ sngon po las mi g.yo ba zar ma'i me tog kha bye ma thag pa lta bu/ g.yas kyi mche ba gtsigs pas ma mchu mnan pa/

spyan gsum dmar la zlum zhing dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ phyag g.yas ral gri 'phyar zhing g.yon zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub thugs kar mdzad pa/ zhabs g.yas tsog pu/ g.yon nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la rab tu btsugs pa lha'i na bza' mnabs pa/ snying gar ral gri chang zung la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ rigs bdag mi bskyod pa'o/ sngags ni/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro kha ṇa hūm̐ phaṭḥ zhes bzla'o// 48 seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ paṃ las pad+ma a las zla ba la/ tāṃ ljang ga las margad kyi mdangs 'dzin pa'i 'phags ma sgrol ma mdzes pa thams cad kyi phul du phyin kyang*/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis yid du 'ong bar bgyid bzhin pa bcu drug lon pa'i lang tsho can/ phyag g.yas skyabs sbyin dang g.yon ut+pal mthing ga'i sdong bu 'dzin cing*/ zur phud la don yod grub pas brgyan pa/ skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis bzhugs pa/ g.yas su mya ngan med pa'i shing gi 'od zer dang*/ g.yon du ral gcig ma gnyis gzhon nu ma seng ldeng gi nags su sna tshogs pa'i sems can gyi don mdzad pa/ rigs bdag don grub bo// sngags ni/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 49 sgrol ma chen mo'i sgrub thabs ni/ paṃ las pad+ma a las zla ba la/ tāṃ ljang ga las margan kyi mdangs 'dzin pa'i 'phags ma sgrol ma mdzes pa thams cad kyi phul du phyin kyang*/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis yid du 'ong bar bgyid bzhin pa bcu drug lon pa'i lang tsho can/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon ut+pal mthing ga'i sdong bu 'dzin cing*/ zur phud la don yod grub pas brgyan pa/ skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis bzhugs pa/

rigs bdag don grub bo// sngags ni/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 50 mchog sbyin sgrol ma lha lnga'i sgrub thabs ni/ paṃ las pad+ma a las zla ba la/ tāṃ ljang ga las margad kyi mdangs 'dzin pa'i 'phags ma sgrol ma mdzes pa thams cad kyi phul du phyin kyang*/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis yid du 'ong bar bgyid bzhin pa bcu drug lon pa'i lang tsho can/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon ut+pal mthing ga'i sdong bu 'dzin cing*/ zur phud la don yod grub pas brgyan pa/ skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis bzhugs pa/ g.yas su mya ngan med pa'i 'od zer can ser mo bā ku li dang mya ngan med pa'i shing gi yal ga de'i mthar rma bya chen mo rnga yab dang rma bya'i sgro/ g.yon du ral gcig ma sngon mo thung zhing stag sham can/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa'i zhal mche ba gtsigs shing gri gug dang thod pa/ de'i mthar dug sel ma ljang gu rnga yab dang sbrul nag po/ lha mo gsum zhi ba rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ rigs bdag don grub bo// sngags ni/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 51 dbang du byed pa'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ paṃ las pad+ma a las zla ba la/ tāṃ ljang ga las margad kyi mdangs 'dzin pa'i 'phags ma sgrol ma mdzes pa thams cad kyi phul du phyin kyang*/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis yid du 'ong bar bgyid bzhin pa bcu drug lon pa'i lang tsho can/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon ut+pal mthing ga'i sdong bu 'dzin cing*/ zur phud la don yod grub pas brgyan cing*/ bzang po'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag don yod grub pa'o// sngags ni/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ che ge mo dbang du gyis shig swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 52 rdo rje sgrol ma lha bcu gcig gi sgrub thabs ni/ pad zla la raṃ ser po las sam raṃ las nyi ma/ hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje de las rwa gur/

nang du chos 'byung*/ de'i nang du 'byung ba bzhi'i dkyil 'khor du/ bh+rūṃ las 'khor lo ser po/ 'byung bzhi'i 'khor lo rnams yongs su gyur pa las thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi rta bab la sogs mtshan nyid rdzogs pa'i dbus su/ dbyangs so gnyis las zla ba la tāṃ las rdo rje tāṃ gyis mtshan pa/ kā li brgyad cu las nyi ma gcig tu 'dres pa/ de las rdo rje sgrol ma gser gyi mdog can 'od dmar po 'phro ba/ ser nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal bzhi phyag brgyad kyi g.yas rdo rje/ zhags pa/ mdung*/ mda'/ g.yon rdo rje'i lcags kyu/ ut+pal/ gzhu/ zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing*/ sangs rgyas lnga'i cod pan can/ gzhon zhing yid du 'ong ba/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ mdun du.oṃ las me tog sgrol ma dkar mo/ lhor tā las bdug spos sgrol ma sngon mo/ nub tu re las mar me sgrol ma ser mo/ byang du tuta las dri sgrol ma dkar dmar/ shar sgor tā las rdo rje lcags kyu ma nag mo/ lho sgor re las rdo rje zhags pa ma ser mo/ nub sgor tu las rdo rje lcags sgrog ma dmar mo/ byang sgor re las rdo rje dril bu ma dkar mo bzhi khro mo/ thams cad kyi phyag g.yas na rang ming dang mthun pa'i rdzas bsnams pa/ g.yas brkyang gis nyi ma la bzhugs pa/ steng du swā las gtsug tor rnam rgyal ma ser mo 'khor lo/ 'og tu hā las gnod mdzes ma nag mo sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ lha mo drug ka g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ phyag g.yas par rdo rje/ mda'/ mdung*/ mchog sbyin zhes bshad pa'ang yod do// mig la gti mug rdo rje/ rna bar zhe sdang rdo rje/ sna la ser sna rdo rje/ lce la 'dod chags rdo rje/ lus la phrag dog rdo rje/ yid la dbang phyug ma dang drug go/ rigs bdag ni/ gtso mo la rin 'byung*/ me tog sgrol ma dang rdo rje lcags kyu ma zung la rnam snang*/

bdug spos sgrol ma dang rdo rje zhags pa ma zung la mi bskyod pa/ mar me sgrol ma dang rdo rje lcags sgrog ma zung la 'od dpag med/ dri chab sgrol ma dang rdo rje dril bu ma zung la don grub/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal ma la rin 'byung*/ gnod mdzes ma la mi bskyod pa'o// sngags ni/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 53 rdo rje sgrol ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs ni/ paṃ las pad dkar 'dab brgyad kyi steng du a las zla ba'i gdan la/ tāṃ las ut+pal dkar po'i dbus su zla ba tāṃ yig can las sgrol ma'i sku 'phro bas/ sems can gyi don mdzad de khams gsum dang bcas pa de la slar zhugs pa rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje sgrol ma dkar mo mchog sbyin dang ut+pal bsnams shing*/ zla ba la rgyab brten te rdo rje skyil krung gis pad zla la bzhugs pa/ bdud ma lus pa 'joms par mdzad cing ba spu'i khung nas sangs rgyas dang byang sems kyi tshogs 'phro ba/ rigs bdag don grub bo// sngags ni/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 54 sgrol ma sngon mo'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad zla la tāṃ ljang ga las margad kyi mdangs 'dzin pa'i 'phags ma sgrol ma mdzes pa thams cad kyi phul du phyin kyang*/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis yid du 'ong bar bgyid bzhin pa bcu drug pa'i lang tsho can/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon ut+pal mthing ga'i sdong bu 'dzin cing*/ zur phud la don yod grub pas brgyan pa/ skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag don grub bo// sngags ni/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 55 'jigs pa brgyad skyob kyi sgrub thabs ni/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar tāṃ las margad kyi mdangs 'dzin pa'i 'phags ma sgrol ma mdzes pa thams cad kyi phul du phyin kyang*/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis yid du 'ong bar bgyid bzhin pa bcu drug pa'i lang tsho can/

phyag g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon ut+pal mthing ga'i sdong bu 'dzin cing*/ zur phud la don yod grub pas brgyan pa/ skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis bzhugs pa/ 'dab ma brgyad la/ sa bon brgyad las 'jigs pa brgyad skyob pa'i lha mo brgyad gtso mo lta bu/ rigs bdag don grub bo// sngags ni/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ zhes gtso mo'i yi ge bcu pa dang*/ oṃ oṃ swā hā/ zhes shar/ oṃ tā swā hā/ zhes lho'i/ oṃ re swā hā/ zhes nub/ oṃ tuta swā hā/ zhes byang*/ oṃ tā swā hā/ zhes me/ oṃ re swā hā/ zhes bden bral/ oṃ tu swā hā/ zhes rlung*/ oṃ re swā hā/ zhes dbang ldan bcas kyi bzla'o// 56 rgya nag rim pa'i 'phags ma sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ a las pad+ma dmar po'i steng du/ tāṃ las thod pa'i nang du/ hūm̐ nag po las gri gug sa bon dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ sgrol ma sku mdog nag mo zhal gdangs shing mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa'i gad rgyangs mi bzad pa/ spyan gsum dmar po/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis ral gri dang gri gug g.yon gnyis ut+pal dang thod pa/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan cing ral pa kham pa'i thor tshugs can/ thung zhing lto ba 'phyang ba shin tu 'jigs pa'i sku/ klu brgyad dang mgo'i ga shal/ stag sham gyis brgyan te g.yon brkyang gi ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag mi bskyod pa'o// sngags ni/ oṃ hrīḥhūm̐ phaṭḥ ces bzla'o// 57 'chi ba bslu ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad zla la tāṃ dkar po las ston zla lta bu'i sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo mdzes sdug gi dpyid bsdus pa/ spyan bdun mnga' ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon ut+pal dkar po'i sdong bu 'dzin pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan nas rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ snying gar yid bzhin 'khor lo dkar po'i lte bar tāṃ dang oṃ hā/ rtsibs brgyad la lhag ma'i yi ge brgyad kyis brgyan pa/

rigs bdag 'od dpag med do// sngags ni/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 58 sgrol dkar phyag bzhi ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ paṃ las pad dkar a las zla ba la/ hūm̐ dkar po gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma dkar mo spyan gsum phyag bzhi ma/ rtsa phyag gnyis ut+pa la'i phyag rgya/ lhag ma yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'dzin pa'i mchog sbyin dang ut+pa la'i snye ma thugs kar 'dzin pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i dbu rgyan can/ sna tshogs pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan nas rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ g.yas su 'od zer can ser mo rnga yab dang mya ngan med pa'i shing bsnams pa/ na bza' dmar po/ g.yon du rma bya chen mo ljang khu rnga yab dang rma bya'i sgro phon bsnams pa'i lha mo mdzes ma/ rigs bdag rigs lnga'o// sngags ni/ oṃ na mastā re ma no hā re hūm̐ hā ra swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 59 sgrol dkar zhal gsum phyag drug ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ paṃ las pad dkar a las zla ba la/ hūm̐ dkar po gnas pa yongs su gyur pa'i ut+pal dkar po sa bon dang bcas pas don gnyis mdzad pa'i 'od kyi spro bsdu can yongs su gyur pa'i bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol dkar/ dkar ser sngo ba'i zhal gsum/ re re la'ang spyan gsum gsum mnga' ba/ phyag drug gi g.yas pas mchog sbyin/ bgrang 'phreng*/ mda'/ g.yon pas ut+pal/ pad+ma/ gzhu/ zla phyed kyis mdzes pa'i ral pa'i thor gtsug la don yod grub pas brgyan pa/ thod pa lnga'i cod pan sogs rgyan gos sna tshogs pas spras pa brgyad gnyis kyi lang tsho can/ skyil krung phyed pas dur khrod kyi dbus na zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag don grub bo// sngags ni/ oṃ ā tsa le a ni mi sa tā ba re hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 60 sgrol ma dug sel ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ paṃ las pad+ma dkar po 'dab brgyad/ a las zla bar/ hrīḥdakar po las bcom ldan 'das sgrol ma dug sel ma dkar mo ral pa'i cod pan can/

na bza' dang rin po che dang sbrul gyi rgyan thams cad dkar po/ phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis pi waṃ sgreng ba/ lhag ma sbrul dkar po dang mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya/ zla ba lta bu'i 'od zer can sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ spyi mgrin nu ma'i bar du zla ba la āḥhrīḥhūm̐ gnas pa/ rigs bdag rdo rje sems dpa'o// sngags ni/ hrī zhes bzla'o// 61 sgrol ma nor sbyin ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las raṃ las nyi ma/ hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje/ de'i 'phreng ba las byung ba'i rwa gur nang sna tshogs rdo rje'i gur/ paṃ las pad+ma a las zla ba/ bh+rūṃ las 'khor lo rang gi sa bon gyis mtshan pa rnams gcig tu 'dres pa las/ gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa mtshan nyid thams cad rdzogs pa'i nang du pad 'dab brgyad/ zla ba dgu sgo bzhir nyi ma bzhi'i gdan dang ldan pa'i dbus su/ tāṃ yig don gnyis mdzad pa'i 'phro 'du can yongs su gyur pa'i bcom ldan 'das nor sbyin sgrol ma sku mdog ljang sngon/ zhal gcig spyan gnyis phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas bgrang 'phreng dang mchog sbyin/ g.yon ut+pal dang po ti bsnams pa/ gos dang rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan te sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ spyi bo/ dpral ba/ spyan/ mgrin pa/ dpung pa/ snying ga lte ba/ gsang gnas/ pus mo/ rkang bcur/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ zhes rim pa bzhin 'khod pa/ shar du rdo rje sgrol ma nag mo rdo rje/ lhor rin chen sgrol ma ser mo rin chen/ nub tu pad+ma sgrol ma dmar mo pad+ma/ byang du sangs rgyas sgrol ma dkar mo 'khor lo/ mer me tog sgrol ma dkar mo me tog gi 'phreng ba/ srin por bdug spos sgrol ma nag mo spos phor/ rlung du mar me'i sgrol ma dmar mo mar me/ dbang ldan du dri'i sgrol ma dkar mo dung chos/ g.yon rnams ut+pal bsnams pa/ mdzes shing rgyan gos thams cad kyis spras te sems skyil gyis bzhugs pa/

sgo bzhir rdo rje lcags kyu ma/ rdo rje zhags pa ma/ rdo rje lcags sgrog ma/ rdo rje dril bu ma rnams/ g.yas rang ming gi phyag mtshan dang g.yon ut+pal/ khro mo sbrul gyis dkris shing stag sham gsol te g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag don grub bo// sngags ni/ oṃ tā re tut+ta re tu re dha na mi swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 62 ngan song las sgrol ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ skad cig gis ngan song las sgrol ba'i sgrol ma ljang sngon ma/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis lcags kyu dang mchog sbyin/ g.yon gnyis zhags pa dang ut+pal/ mdzes pa'i 'phreng ba dang na bza' mnabs pa/ pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs te sbrul gyis bcings pa thams cad sgrol bar mdzad pa/ rigs bdag rdo rje sems dpa'o// sngags ni/ na maḥ.ar+ya a wa lo ke te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi sa twa ya/ ma hā sa twa ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tad+ya thā/ na mo bha ga wa te ār+ya tā ra yai/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re be re durga ut+ta rā ya/ hrīṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ/ sarba duḥkha khata lo tsa na bha ga wa ti durga ta rā ṇi ma hā yo gaṣ+ṇa te hriṃ na ma tu re swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 63 sna tshogs yum gyi sgrub thabs ni/ zla nyi kha sbyar ba'i dbus su ā li kā lis bskor ba'i phreṃ dkar po las chu skyes de dag thams cad gcig tu 'dres pa las/ sna tshogs yum zla ba lta bu'i zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis chu skyes 'dzin cing na bza' dkar po mnabs pa/ rgyan dkar pos brgyan pa/ rigs bdag rdo rje sems dpa'o// sngags ni/ oṃ phreṃ swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 64 don thams cad rab tu sbyin pa'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ bha ga'i dbus su zla ba la lha mo sgrol ma chen mo gser mdog can/ zhal brgyad kyi rtsa zhal ser po/ g.yas gsum nag ljang sngo/ g.yon gsum dkar dmar sngo/ steng zhal dud kha 'jigs pa/ spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag bcu drug gi g.yas brgyad ral gri/

ut+pal/ mda'/ rdo rje/ lcags kyu/ dbyug pa/ gri gug mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya/ g.yon pas zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub/ thod pa/ gzhu/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga rdo rje dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ tshangs mgo rin po che/ bum pa bsnams pa/ mgo bo'i 'phreng ba 'phyang zhing rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ nyi ma'i 'od 'chang ba/ zhabs g.yas brkyang gis dbang po dang drag po dang tshangs pa dang khyab 'jug la gnas pa/ rigs bdag don grub bo// sngags ni/ oṃ pra pan na tā re a mṛ ta mu khi a mṛ ta/ lo tsa ni sarba ar+thā sa dha ni/ sarba sa twa wa shaṃ ka ri hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces bzla'o// 65 sgrol ma sna tshogs pa'i mdog gi sgrub thabs ni/ skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das sgrol ma dmar ljang nag dkar sna tshogs pa'i kha dog can/ phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis zhags pa dang dung*/ lhag ma gnyis ut+pal dang lcags kyu/ rgyan gyis brgyan nas skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag don grub bo// sngags ni/ oṃ truṃ truṃ truṃ truṃ truṃ/ zhes snying po dang*/ tāṃ tā tī tā+e/

zhes nye snying bzla'o// 66 dug sel ma ser mo zhal gsum phyag drug ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad zla la dzaṃ yig ser po las 'phags ma dug sel ma sku mdog ser mo/ ser sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum sbrul mgo bdun gyis mdzes pa/ phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na ral gri/ rdo rje/ mda'/ g.yon gsum sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ dug gi me tog gzhu bkang ba/ sbrul dang mdzes pa'i gos dang rgyan gyis brgyan pa gzhon nu'i lang tsho can/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan cing rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag mi bskyod pa'o// sngags ni/ oṃ dzaṃ gu li sarba bi ṣa pra sha ma ni phuḥswā hā/ rdo rje ral gri zhes kyang 'ga' zhig las so// yang na/ oṃ na maḥsha wa ra ku mā ri yi tsur tshaṃ tso dri tsā la ya tsuts+tsha la ya saṃ gīṭ+ṭa mirta mā tāṃ g+gi a ṭa bid+dhe a h+ya oṃ dza swā hā/ zhes kyang bzla'o// 67 dug sel ma ljang mo phyag bzhi ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ skad cig gis 'phags ma dug sel ma sku mdog ljang gu gdengs ka bdun gyis mdzes pa'i zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ phyag dang po gnyis rtse gsum dang rma bya'i sgro/ gnyis par gnyis sbrul dang mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya/ yan lag sbrul gyis brgyan te ba spu'i khung bu thams cad nas me kun tu 'byung ba rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag mi bskyod pa'o// sngags ni/ oṃ a si dzi hwe shu la dzi hwe badz+ra ka ye gra sa gra sa dz+wa la dz+wa la ma hā dz+wa la ma hā yo gi shwa rī hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/ zhes bzla/ dkar mo sgrol ma'i khongs su song ngo*// 68 ral gcig ma phyag nyer bzhi ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ ra las nyi ma rwa gur gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa'i dbus su/ hūm̐ yig las thod pa dkar po'i khar rdo rje nag po gnas pa yongs su gyur pa'i bcom ldan 'das ral gcig ma zhal bcu gnyis kyi dang po nag po/ g.yas lnga dkar ser dmar ljang du ba'i mdog

g.yon lnga dmar ser ljang dkar dmar ba/ steng zhal dud kha/ thams cad khro mo bzhin la 'bar ba'i spyan gsum mnga' ba/ phyag nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i g.yas rnams kyis ral gri/ rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ 'khri shing*/ lcags kyu/ mdung*/ tho ba/ gtun shing*/ gri gug ḍā ma ru/ bgrang 'phreng*/ mda'/ g.yon mas rim gyis gzhu/ zhags pa/ sdigs mdzub/ ba dan/ dbyug pa/ rtse gsum/ chang snod/ ut+pal/ dril bu/ sta re/ tshangs mgo thod pa bsnams shing*/ klu brgyad dang mi mgo dang phyag rgya drug gis brgyan te thung la lto ba 'phyang zhing nu 'bur rgyas pa/ ral pa gyen du brdzes pa la mi bskyod pas dbu rgyan cing stag sham can/ thod pa dkar po khrag gis gang ba'i steng ro'i gdan la g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ gtsug tor/ dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying ga lte ba/ lte 'og gsang bar rim pa bzhin/ hūm̐ oṃ āḥhrī triṃ hūm̐ traṃ/ rkang pa dag la/ oṃ āḥphaṭ swā hā/ rigs bdag mi bskyod pa'o// sngags ni/ oṃ hriṃ s+t+riṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ zhes snying po dang*/ hrīṃ s+t+riṃ hūm̐/ zhes nye snying bcas bzla'o// 69 ral gcig ma phyag bzhi ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng du tāṃ las thod pa'i nang du hūm̐ sngon po/ de las bcom ldan 'das ral gcig ma khro mo'i bzhin la 'bar ba'i spyan gsum mnga' ba/ phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis gri gug dang thod pa/ lhag ma gnyis kyi g.yas ral gri yongs su gyur pa'i bgrang 'phreng*/ g.yon ut+pal/ klu brgyad dang mi mgo dang phyag rgya drug gis brgyan te thung la lto ba 'phyang zhing nu 'bur rgyas pa/ ral pa gyen du brdzes pa la mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan cing stag sham can/ thod pa dkar po khrag gis gang ba'i steng du ro'i gdan la g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ gtsug tor/ dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying ga lte ba/ lte 'og gsang bar rim pa bzhin/ hūm̐ oṃ āḥhrīṃḥtriṃ hūm̐ traṃ/ rkang pa dag la/ oṃ āḥphaṭ swā hā/

rigs bdag mi bskyod pa'o// sngags ni/ oṃ hrīṃ trīṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces bzla/ ral gri dang thod pa mda' gzhu bsnams pa'ang 'gyur ro// 70 phyag gnyis ma ral gcig ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng du tāṃ las thod pa'i nang du hūm̐ sngon po/ de las bcom ldan 'das ral gcig ma khro mo'i bzhin la 'bar ba'i spyan gsum mnga' ba/ phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ klu brgyad dang mi mgo dang phyag rgya drug gis brgyan te thung la lto ba 'phyang zhing nu 'bur rgyas pa/ ral pa gyen du brdzes pa la mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan cing stag sham can/ thod pa dkar po khrag gis gang ba'i steng ro'i gdan la g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ gtsug tor/ dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying ga lte ba/ lte 'og gsang bar rim pa bzhin/ hūm̐ oṃ āḥhrīḥtriṃ hūm̐ traṃ/ rkang pa dag la/ oṃ āḥphaṭḥswā hā/ rigs bdag mi bskyod pa'o// sngags ni/ hrīṃ triṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces bzla'o// 71 ral gcig ma phyag brgyad ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng du tāṃ las thod pa'i nang du hūm̐ sngon po/ de las bcom ldan 'das ral gcig ma khro mo'i bzhin la 'bar ba'i spyan gsum mnga' ba/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yas bzhir ral gri/ mda'/ rdo rje/ gri gug g.yon bzhir ut+pal/ gzhu/ sta re/ thod pa/ klu brgyad dang mi mgo dang phyag rgya drug gis brgyan te thung la lto ba 'phyang zhing nu 'bur rgyas pa/ ral pa gyen du brdzes pa la mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan cing stag sham can/ thod pa dkar po khrag gis gang ba'i steng ro'i gdan la g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ gtsug tor/ dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying ga lte ba/ lte 'og gsang bar rim pa bzhin/ hūm̐ oṃ āḥhri triṃ hūm̐ traṃ/ rkang pa dag la/ oṃ āḥphaṭ swā hā/ rigs bdag mi bskyod pa'o// sngags ni/ hriṃ triṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces bzla'o// 72 lha mo tsun+da'i sgrub thabs ni/

pad zla la oṃ tsu las lha mo tsun+da ston ka'i zla ba lta bur mdzes ma/ phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis mchog sbyin dang po tis mtshan pa'i pad+ma/ lhag ma gnyis kyis lhung bzed/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa rdo rje sems dpa'i cod pan can/ pad zla la sems skyil gyis gnas pa/ rigs bdag rdo rje sems dpa'o// sngags ni/ oṃ tsa le tsu le tsun+de swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 73 'od zer can dkar mo phyag bcu ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad zla la māṃ dkar po las/ 'od zer can dkar mo zhal lnga'i rtsa zhal dkar po/ g.yas nag rgyab ljang*/ g.yon phag zhal dmar po/ steng zhal ser po/ phyag bcu'i g.yas lnga nyi ma/ rdo rje sngon po/ mnga' dang*/ lcags kyu/ khab dang*/ g.yon lnga zla ba/ mya ngan med pa'i lo ma dang*/ gzhu dang*/ zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub dang*/ skud pa/ zur phud gsum rin po ches brgyan pa/ gzhon nu ma stod g.yogs dkar po can/ mchod rten gyi nang na gnas shing*/ 'og na nyi ma la sogs pa'i gza' dgu dang nad kyi tshogs mnan pa'i phag bdun gyi shing rta la zhon pa/ khyab 'jug dang*/ dbang po dang*/ bde byed dang*/ tshangs pa rnams zhabs bzhis mnan pa/ shing rta'i mdun du chu srin mnan pa'i phag gdong can nag mo rdo rje sdigs mdzub can/ g.yas su phag gdong dmar mo/ g.yas gnyis lcags kyu dang khab/ g.yon gnyis zhags pa dang ldan pa'i sdigs mdzub dang skud pa/ g.yon du phag gdong can dkar mo rna ba'i dbus su bkang ba'i gzhu dang mda'/ 'og ma gnyis rdo rje dang mya ngan med pa'i shing gi yal ga rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ rigs bdag rnam snang ngo*// sngags ni/ oṃ mā ri ts+yai māṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 74 'od zer can ser mo phyag gnyis ma'am mya ngan med pa'i shing gi 'od zer can ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ zla ba la maṃ' ser mo las mya ngan med pa'i shing*/ de'i steng du maṃ/ de yongs su gyur pa las 'od zer can sku mdog ser mo/

zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang mya ngan med pa'i shing gi yal ga rnam snang gis dbu brgyan cing*/ gzhon nu ma mdzes pa'i rgyan gyis spras te phag ser po'i steng du zla ba la 'gying bag dang bcas te bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag rnam snang ngo*// sngags ni/ oṃ mā ri ts+yai maṃ swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 75 rtogs pa las gsungs pa'i 'od zer can ma ser mo phyag brgyad ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i dbus su/ oṃ las rnam snang ser po rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs shing byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya mdzad pa zhi ba/ de'i thugs kar māṃ las mya ngan med pa'i shing māṃ gyis mtshan pa'i 'od kyis don gnyis byas te de nyid la thim/ thams cad yongs su gyur pa las 'od zer can gser mdog g.yas zhal dmar/ g.yon sngo ba'i phag zhal khro ba/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yas bzhir rdo rje/ lcags kyu/ mda' dang*/ khab/ g.yon bzhir mya ngan med pa'i shing gi yal ga sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ gzhu dang*/ skud pa/ rnam snang dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ gzhon nu ma stod g.yogs dmar po can/ mchod rten nang phag bdun gyi shing rta'i steng na yaṃ las rlung dkyil haṃ las zla nyi 'dzin pa'i gza' mnan te g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa'i/ shar du brta li dmar mo phag gdong*/ phyag bzhi khab dang lcags kyu/ zhags pa dang mya ngan med pa'i yal ga lhor ba dā li ser mo khab dang mya ngan med pa'i shing*/ nub tu ba rā li dkar mo phyag bzhir rdo rje dang khab/ zhags pa dang mya ngan med pa'i yal ga lha mo mdzes ma/ byang du phag zhal ma dmar mo mig gsum ma/ phyag bzhir rdo rje/ mda'/ gzhu dang*/ mya ngan med pa'i shing gi yal ga bsnams pa/ de kun g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag rnam snang ngo*// sngags ni/ oṃ mā ri ts+yai maṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/ zhes sam/ yang na/ oṃ ma ri ts+yai swā hā/ zhes bzla'o//

76 rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma'i 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs ni/ oṃ yig las skyes pa'i rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma'i 'od zer can dmar mo lto ba 'phyang zhing brjid pa/ zhal drug las lnga po dmar nag ljang ser dkar ba rnams g.yas bskor dang*/ steng du phag zhal nag po bcas shin tu khro ba/ spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ ral pa rnam snang gis brgyan pa/ phyag bcu gnyis kyi g.yas pa drug na ral gri/ gtun shing*/ mda'/ lcags kyu/ rdo rje rtse gsum/ dgra sta/ g.yon pa drug na zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub/ thod pa/ mya ngan med pa'i yal ga tshangs mgo gzhu/ rtse gsum/ khro mo'i chas kyis brgyan pa'i zhabs zung gis bgegs dpag tu med pa mnan te/ mchod rten gyi nang na nyi ma la g.yon brkyang gis shing rta'i dbus su bzhugs pa/ shing rta 'dren pa sdigs mdzub dang mya ngan med pa'i yal ga 'dzin pa g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag rnam snang ngo*// sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra dhā twī shwa ri sarba duṇ+ḍa sa twa na ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ oṃ mā ri ts+yai oṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 77 o ḍī ya na'i 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs ni/ māṃ las 'od zer can dmar mo lto ba 'phyang ba brjid pa/ zhal drug las lnga dmar nag ljang ser dkar ba rnams g.yas bskor dang*/ steng du phag zhal nag po bcas shin tu khro ba/ sbyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ ral pa rnam snang gis brgyan pa/ phyag bcu gnyis kyi g.yas pa drug na ral gri/ rdo rje/ chang snod/ mda'/ rdo rje rtse gcig pa/ dgra sta/ g.yon pa drug na sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ gtun shing*/ mya ngan med pa'i yal ga tshangs mgo gzhu/ rtse gsum/ khro mo'i chas kyis brgyan pa'i zhabs zung gis bgegs dpag tu med pa mnan te/ mchod rten gyi nang na nyi ma la g.yon brkyang gis shing rta'i dbus su bzhugs pa/ 'og tu sna tshogs pa'i phag bdun gyis shing rta 'dren pa/

lha mo gzhan phyag gnyis sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang mya ngan med pa'i shing bsnams pa/ rigs bdag rnam snang ngo*// sngags ni/ oṃ mā ri ts+yai maṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/ zhes bzla/ yang ral gri 'khor lo gtun shing mda' dgra sta/ g.yon chos kyi dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma dang mthun pa la/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga mchan du gzer ba zhig kyang bshad do// 78 rang byin rlabs pa'i 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs ni/ dur khrod brgyad kyi rdo rje'i gur nang rdo rje'i sa gzhir/ dpal o ḍī yā na rang bzhin chos 'byung dmar por/ nyi ma la rdo rje rtse lnga pa yongs su gyur pa'i 'od zer can dmar mo lto ba 'phyang ba/ zhal drug gi rtsa zhal dmar po/ g.yas dkar nag g.yon ser nag gnyis gnyis/ steng phag zhal nag po shin tu khro ba/ spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ ral pa rnam snang gis brgyan pa/ phyag bcu gnyis kyi g.yas pa drug na ral gri/ sna tshogs rdo rje/ rdo rje rtse gcig pa/ dgra sta/ mda'/ gtun shing*/ g.yon pa drug na sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i khab dang rtse gsum/ mya ngan med pa'i yal ga zhags pa/ gzhu/ tshangs mgo rtse gsum/ khro mo'i chas kyis brgyan pa'i zhabs zung gis bgegs dpag tu med pa mnan te g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag rnam snang ngo*// zhal drug ma rnams gzhan chos kyi dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma dang mthun la/ khyad par bshad pa dag go /sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa shwa ri sarba duṣ+ṭaṃn ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ oṃ mā ri ts+yai māṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭḥ zhes bzla'o// 79 'od zer can pi tsu pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ māṃ las mya ngan med pa'i shing*/ de las 'od zer can pi tsu pa gser mdog ser sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag brgyad kyi dang po gnyis gdug pa can gyi kha mig khab kyis 'tshem zhing*/ gnyis pa gnyis kyis snying lcags kyus phug cing zhabs pas bcings pa/ gsum pa gnyis kyis mda' gzhus 'bigs par byed pa/

bzhi pa gnyis kyis rdo rjes mnyed cing mya ngan med pa'i yal gas brabs pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang gis dbang phyug dang gau ri ma brdzis pa/ rigs bdag rnam snang ngo*// sngags ni/ sarba duṣ+ṭa pra duṣ+ṭa naṃ/ zhes bzla'o// 80 'od zer can dmar mo zhal gsum phyag bcu bzhi ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ māṃ las 'khor lo'i lte bar nyi ma la māṃ/ de las bcom ldan 'das ma 'od zer can sku mdog dmar po/ zhal gsum gyi g.yas g.yon phag zhal/ dbus ma zhi zhing cung zad 'dzum pa/ thams cad spyan gsum ma/ phyag dang po gnyis rna bar bkang ba'i mda' gzhu/ lhag ma'i g.yas pa rnams kyis khab dang*/ lcags kyu dang*/ bhi di pā la dang*/ ral gri dang*/ rdo rje'i dbyug pa dang*/ rdo rje/ g.yon pa rnams kyis mya ngan med pa'i me tog snying gar 'dzin pa dang*/ skud pa dang*/ rdo rje'i zhags pa dang*/ thod pa chen po dang*/ mgo bo dang*/ bum pa bzang po bsnams pa/ rnam snang dkar pos dbu brgyan cing dar dmar pos stod g.yogs te rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan nas/ g.yas brkyang gis mchod rten gyi nang na bzhugs pa/ g.yas na lus med tho ba bsnams pas phyag 'tshal zhing*/ g.yon na rdo rje zhags pa 'dzin pa'i dbang pos phyag 'tshal ba/ 'og tu khyab 'jug dbang phyug tshangs pa/ nor lha dang*/ 'jig rten skyong ba thams cad 'dud pa/

rigs bdag rnam snang ngo*// sngags ni/ oṃ mā ri ts+yai swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 81 'od zer can ser mo phyag gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ oṃ rnam par snang mdzad nyid zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod rten zlum po/ zla ba la māṃ las mya ngan med pa'i shing*/ de yongs su gyur pa'i 'od zer can ser mo gos dkar can khro mo/ phyag gnyis khab skud bsnams pa/ rigs bdag rnam snang ngo*// sngags ni/ oṃ ma ri ts+yai swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 82 lo ma gyon ma ser mo zhal gsum phyag drug ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad zla la paṃ ser po las rdo rje paṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de las bcom ldan 'das ri khrod lo ma can sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu/ spyan gsum mnga' ba'i zhal g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus ser ba bzhad cing khro ba/ gzhon sha rgyas shing cung zad lto ba 'phyang zhing sgeg pa'i sku/ lo ma dang rma bya'i mdongs kyi sham thabs can/ phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na rdo rje/ dgra sta/ mda'/ g.yon pa gsum na sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang*/ yal ga dang lhan cig pa'i rma bya'i mdongs/ gzhu bsnams pa/ me tog bcings pa'i ral pa'i cod pan can la mi bskyod pa bzhugs pa/ nyi ma'i 'od can/ bgegs mnan te zhabs g.yas tsog pu/ g.yon pus btsugs rting pa gsang gnas la brten te bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag mi bskyod pa'o// sngags ni/ oṃ pi sha tsi par+ṇa sha wa ri sarba dz+wa ra pra shā ma na swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 83 ri khrod ma ljang mo zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad zla la paṃ ljang khu las/ bcom ldan 'das ri khrod lo ma can sku mdog ljang khu/ ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum bzhad cing khro ba/ gzhon sha rgyas shing cung zad lto ba 'phyang zhing sgeg pa'i sku/ lo ma dang rma bya'i gdongs kyi sham thabs can/ phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na rdo rje/ dgra sta/ mda'/ g.yon pa gsum na sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang*/ yal ga dang lhan cig pa'i rma bya'i gdongs dang*/

gzhu bsnams pa/ me tog bcings pa'i ral pa'i cod pan la don grub bzhugs pa/ nyi ma'i 'od can/ bgegs mnan te zhabs g.yas tsog pu/ g.yon pus btsugs rting pa gsang gnas la brten te bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag don grub bo// sngags ni/ oṃ pi sha tsi par+ṇa sha wa ri sarba dz+wa ra pra shā ma na swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 84 sher phyin dkar mo phyag gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ oṃ las bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma sku mdog dkar mo/ shin tu yid du 'ong ba'i zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas pad+ma dang g.yon shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i po ti bsnams pa/ dbu skra phyed phyed du 'khyil ba la mi bskyod pa dang*/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan te rdo rje skyil krung gis zla ba la bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag mi bskyod pa'o// sngags ni/ oṃ pi tsu pi tsu pra dzñā war+dha ni dz+wa la dz+wa la me dha war+dha ni dhi ri dhi ri bud+dhi war+dha ni swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 85 sher phyin ser mo'i sgrub thabs ni/ a las zla ba la/ dhīḥlas bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma sku mdog ser mo/ yid du 'ong ba'i zhal gcig phyag gnyis chos 'chad pa'i phyag rgya dang ldan pa/ g.yas g.yon gyi logs na ut+pa la'i sdong bur gnas pa'i sher phyin gyi po ti/ dbu skra phyed du 'khyil ba la mi bskyod pa dang*/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan te sna tshogs pad zla la/ g.yon pa'i zhabs g.yas pa'i brla'i steng du gnas shing*/ g.yas skyil krung phyed pa bzhin gyis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag mi bskyod pa'o// sngags ni/ oṃ āḥdhīḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes sam/ yang na/ oṃ dhīḥshru ti smṛ ti bi dza ye swā hā/ zhes kyang bzla'o// 86 sher phyin dkar mo phyag gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ praṃ las sher phyin ma sku mdog dkar mo chos kyi 'khor lo'i phyag rgyas sher phyin gyi po tis mtshan pa'i chu skyes gnyis 'dzin pa/ sna tshogs pad zla la rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/

rigs bdag mi bskyod pa'o// sngags ni/ oṃ praṃ swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 87 sher phyin ma gser mdog phyag bzhi ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ zla ba la dhīḥlas bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma sku mdog ser mo/ yid du 'ong ba'i zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis chos 'chad pa'i phyag rgya dang ldan pa/ phyag lhag ma'i g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon ut+pal sher phyin gyi po tis mdzes pa bsnams pa/ zur phud can rgyan gyis brgyan nas skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ mgrin lce rna bar/ oṃ dhīḥ oṃ gī/ dzīḥ snying gar āḥdamar po las pad+ma 'dab brgyad ze'u 'bru dang bcas pa'i lte bar/ sa bon mdun nas g.yas bskor gyis ze'u 'bru la/ na mo bha ga wa te pradzñā pā ra mi ta yai/ a ma ti gu ṇa ye/ bha ki bats+tsha la ye/ sarba ta thā ga tā dzñā na pā ri pū ri ta ye/ sa twa bats+tsha la yai/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ dhīḥ kar+ṇi ka yāṃ/ mdun ma la/ shu ti/ smṛ ti bi dza ye swā hā/ zhes bkod de bzla'o// rigs bdag mi bskyod pa'o// 88 gser mdog can gyi sher phyin ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ oṃ las zla ba la/ dhī ser po las nang du dbyangs dang phyi rim la gsal byed sum cu rnams dkar po/ 'dab ma la sgeg sogs kyi lha mo brgyad/ de thams cad yongs su gyur pa'i ye shes kyi zla ba/ de las pad+mar sher phyin gyi po ti/ de'i steng du zla ba/ de'i steng du sher phyin gyi po ti gnyis pa/ de thams cad yongs su gyur pa'i bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma sku mdog ser mo/ yid du 'ong ba'i zhal gcig phyag gnyis chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya/ g.yon logs na ut+pa la'i sdong bu sher phyin gyi po tis mtshan pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i dbu rgyan can/ yan lag thams cad de bzhin gshegs pas rgyan du mdzad pa/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis yongs su bskur te phyed skyil gyis bzhugs pa/

rigs bdag rigs lnga'o// sngags ni/ oṃ āḥdhīḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ pradzñā mahā pradzñā shu ti smṛ ti bi dza ye swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 89 'phags ma rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad zla la doḥdamar po las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i snying por/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje dbyangs can ma sku mdog dmar mo/ dmar sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas pad+ma/ ral gri/ gri gug g.yon rdo rje/ lhung bzed/ rin po che'i 'khor lo/ mdzes pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan te g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag 'od dpag med do// sngags ni/ oṃ pi tsu pi tsu pradzñā war+dha ni/ dz+wa la dz+wa la me war+dha ni/ dhi ri dhi ri bud+dhi war+dha ni swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 90 dbyangs can ma chen mo lha lnga'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad zla la hrīḥdakar po las dbyangs can ma chen mo bcu gnyis ma'i lang tsho dang zla ba chu shel gyi mdangs can/ nu ma 'bur zhing sked pa byin gyis phra ba/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing mtshar sdug gi snying por phyin pa/ 'jam pa'i phyag gnyis mchog sbyin/ pad dkar la skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ mdun du shes rab ma/ g.yas su blo can ma/ rgyab tu blo gros ma/ g.yon du dran pa ma rnams gtso mo dang mtshungs pa/ rigs bdag rdo rje sems dpa'o// sngags ni/ oṃ hrī ma hā ma yaṃ ge ma hā swa ra swa t+yai na maḥ zhes bzla'o// 91 rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad zla la hrīḥlas rdo rje dbyangs can ma bcu gnyis ma'i lang tsho dang zla ba chu shel gyi mdangs can/ nu ma 'bur zhing sked pa byin gyis phra ba/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing mtshar sdug gi snying por phyin pa/ 'jam pa'i phyag gnyis kyi g.yas pad+ma dmar po/ g.yon ut+pal po tis mdzes pa 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum pa/ skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag 'od dpag med pa'o// sngags ni/ oṃ pi tsu pi tsu pradzñā war+dha ni/

dz+wa la dz+wa la me dha war+dha ni/ dhi ri dhi ri bud+dhi war+dha ni swā hā/ thiṃlha/ zhes bzla'o// 92 lha mo dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad zla la hrīḥlas dbyangs can ma bcu gnyis lon pa'i lang tsho can sku mdog dkar mo zla ba chu shel gyi mdangs dang ldan pa/ nu ma 'bur zhing sked pa byin gyis phra ba/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing mtshar sdug gi snying por phyin pa/ 'jam pa'i phyag gnyis rin po che'i rgyud mangs sgreng ba/ zho 'thung byis pa dang mtshungs pa cung zad tsog pur zla ba la bzhugs pa/ snying gar 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar hrīṃ/ rigs bdag rdo rje sems dpa'o// sngags ni/ hrīṃ/ zhes bzla'o// 93 gshin rje gshed nag po'i rgyud las phyung pa'i rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ zla ba la doḥlas chu skyes sa bon dos mtshan pa/ 'od kyis sems can gyi don byas te rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i go 'phang la bkod/ thams cad bsdus nas de la thim pa las/ rdo rje dbyangs can ma dmar mo/ dmar dkar nag pa'i zhal can/ phyag drug gi g.yas po tis mtshan pa'i pad+ma/ ral gri/ gri gug g.yon 'khor lo/ pi waṃ/ tshangs mgo skra dmar ser brdzes pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan nas zla ba dmar mo'i steng du g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag rnam snang ngo*// sngags ni/ oṃ pi tsu pi tsu pradzñā war+dha ni/ dz+wa la dz+wa la me dha war+d+dha ni/ dhi ri dhi ri bud+dhi war+dha ni swā hā/ thiṃlha/ zhes bzla'o// 94 khro gnyer can gyi sgrub thabs ni/ bh+rāṃ ser po las khro gnyer can ser mo zhal gcig spyan gsum pa/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas mchog sbyin dang bgrang 'phreng*/ g.yon rtse gsum dang spyi blugs/ gzhon nu 'od dpag med dang rgyan gyis spras te/ pad zla la skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag 'od dpag med do// sngags ni/ oṃ bh+rūṃ ku ku ṭi swā hā/ yang na/ oṃ bh+rūṃ swā hā/
