zhes bzla'o// 95 sgrol ma'i rtogs pa las gsungs pa'i ku ru kul+le'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad zla la a las ut+pal dmar po'i steng du/ a las zla ba sa bon gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das ku ru kul+le ma sku mdog dmar mo/ zhal gcig shin tu khro zhing spyan gsum dmar zlum g.yon du lta ba/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas mchog sbyin dang mda'/ g.yon ut+pal dang gzhu/ gos dang rgyan dmar po/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan te/ ku ru kul+le'i ri'i phug na sgra gcan gyi steng gi pad dmar la gnas pa'i 'dod lha chung mar bcas pa'i steng du rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag 'od dpag med do// sngags ni/ oṃ ku ru kul+le hrīṃḥswā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 96 ku ru kul+le'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad zla la a las ut+pal dmar po'i steng du/ a las zla ba la sa bon tāṃ mam hrīḥyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das ma ku ru kul+le sku mdog dmar po/ zhal gcig shin tu khro zhing spyan gsum dmar zlum g.yon du lta ba/ phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis ut+pa la'i mda' gzhu 'gengs pa/ lhag ma mchog sbyin dang ut+pal/ gos dang rgyan dmar po/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan te/ ku ru kul+le'i ri'i phug na sgra gcan gyi steng gi pad dmar la gnas pa'i 'dod lha chung mar bcas pa'i steng du rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag 'od dpag med do// sngags ni/ oṃ ku ru kul+le hrīḥswā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 97 yang ku ru kul+le'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad zla la a las ut+pal dmar po'i steng du/ a las zla ba la sa bon tāṃ mam hrīḥyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das ma ku ru kul+le sku mdog dmar mo/ zhal gcig shin tu khro zhing spyan gsum dmar zlum g.yon du lta ba/ phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya dang nor bu/ lhag ma gnyis mda' dang gzhu/

gos dang rgyan dmar po/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan te/ ku ru kul+le'i ri'i phug na sgra gcan gyi steng gi pad dmar la gnas pa'i 'dod lha chung mar bcas pa'i steng du rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag 'od dpag med do// sngags ni/ oṃ ku ru kul+le hrīḥ.a mu ka me ba shaṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 98 o ḍī ya ṇa las byung ba'i rig byed ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ rwa gur gyi nang du chos 'byung pad zla'i gdan la/ hrīḥdamar mo las ut+pal dmar po'i ze'u 'brur/ nyi ma la hrīḥyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das ma ku ru kul+le sku mdog dmar mo/ zhal gcig shin tu khro zhing spyan gsum dmar zlum g.yon du lta ba/ ro'i gdan la skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis bzhugs pa/ gzhon zhing stag sham can/ phyag rgya lngas rnam par brgyan pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa la 'od dpag tu med pa bzhugs pa/ rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis kyis me tog dmar po'i gzhu dang ut+pala'i mde'u can gyi mda' rna ba'i rtsar 'gengs pa/ phyag lhag ma gnyis kyis ut+pa la'i zhags pa dang pad+ma dmar po'i lcags kyu bsnams pa/ rigs bdag 'od dpag med do// sngags ni/ oṃ ku ru kul+le hrīḥ zhes bzla'o// 99 kyai rdo rje las gsungs pa'i ku ru kul+le'i sgrub thabs ni/ hrīḥdamar po las ut+pal dmar po'i ze'u 'brur/ nyi ma la hrīḥyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das ma ku ru kul+le sku mdog dmar mo/ zhal gcig shin tu khro zhing spyan gsum dmar zlum g.yon du lta ba/ ro'i gdan la skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis bzhugs pa/ phyag rgya lngas rnam par brgyan pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa la 'od dpag tu med pa bzhugs pa/ rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis kyis me tog dmar po'i gzhu dang ut+pa la'i mde'u can gyi mda' rna ba'i rtsar 'gengs pa/ phyag lhag ma gnyis kyis lcags kyu dang ut+pal dmar po bsnams pa/

stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ rigs bdag 'od dpag med do// sngags ni/ oṃ ku ru kul+le hrīḥswā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 100 ku ru kul+le phyag drug ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ snying gar zla ba la hūm̐ las khams gsum dbang du byas pas lus la zhugs pa yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das ma ku ru kul+le sku mdog dmar mo/ zhal gcig shin tu khro zhing spyan gsum dmar zlum g.yon du lta ba/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis 'jig rten gsum las rgyal ba'i phyag rgya/ gnyis pa gnyis lcags kyu dang ut+pal/ mtha' ma gnyis mda' gzhu rna ba'i bar du 'gengs pa/ rgyan gyis brgyan te rdo rje skyil krung gis pad nyi la bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag rigs lnga'o// sngags ni/ oṃ ku ru kul+le hrīḥswā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 101 rig byed ma phyag brgyad ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ gzhal yas khang gi dbus su pad zla la/ hūm̐ las khams gsum dbang du byas pas lus la zhugs pa yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das ma ku ru kul+le sku mdog dmar mo/ zhal gcig shin tu khro zhing spyan gsum dmar zlum g.yon du lta ba/ phyag brgyad kyi dang po gnyis 'jig rten gsum rgyal gyi phyag rgya/ lhag ma'i g.yas lcags kyu/ rna ba'i rtsar 'gengs pa'i mda'/ mchog sbyin/ g.yon zhags pa/ gzhu/ ut+pal/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan te pad nyi la rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ shar du dwangs pa'i sgrol ma/ lhor rdzogs pa'i sgrol ma/ nub tu rgyal ba'i sgrol ma/ byang du rna ba'i sgrol ma/ dbang ldan du tsun+da/ mer gzhan gyis mi thub ma/ bden bral du mar me'i sgrol ma/ rlung du gau ri'i sgrol ma/ thams cad kyang ser mo rgyan gyis brgyan te/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga lngas dbu brgyan pa rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ shar sgor rdo rje ro langs ma dmar mo/ g.yas sdigs mdzub dang lcags kyu/ g.yon dril bu dang zhags pa/ lho sgor gzhan gyis mi thub ma ser mo/

g.yas dbyug pa dang lcags kyu/ g.yon dril bu dang zhags pa/ nub sgor ral gcig ma nag mo/ g.yas rdo rje dang lcags kyu/ g.yon dril bu dang zhags pa/ byang sgor rdo rje gan+dha ri ljang kha/ g.yas kha ṭ+wāṃ dang lcags kyu/ g.yon dril bu dang zhags pa/ khro mo'i chas can zhabs g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/

rigs bdag rigs lnga'o// sngags ni/ oṃ ku ru kul+le hrīḥswā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 102 rig byed ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs ni/ hrīḥlas ut+pal zla ba sa bon gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rig byed ma bdud rtsi 'dzag cing zla ba lta bu'i sku'i phyag gnyis ut+pa la'i bgrang phreng dang bdud rtsi bum pa bsnam pa/ spyan gsum pa/ sangs rgyas rig ma dang bcas pas dbang bskur bzhin pa/ klu brgyad kyis brgyan te pad zla la skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag 'od dpag med do// sngags ni/ oṃ ku ru kul+le swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 103 rig byed ma dkar mo phyag drug ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ hrīḥlas rig byed ma sku mdog dkar mo dbu skra dmar ser thod pa lngas brgyan pa/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis 'jig rten gsum rgyal gyi phyag rgya/ de'i 'og ma gnyis mi 'jigs pa dang kun+da dkar po'i dog pa/ lhag ma gnyis bgrang 'phreng dang spyi blugs/ rgyan gyis mdzes pas gzhon zhing bya khyung gi gdan la rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag 'od dpag med do// sngags ni/ oṃ k+ṣa ku ru kul+le hrīḥn mo bau ṣa ṭa swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 104 gtsug tor rnam rgyal ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad zla la bh+rūṃ dkar po las gtsug tor rnam rgyal ma zla ba lta bur dkar ba/ g.yas zhal ser po zhi ba/ g.yon zhal nag po khro ba/ rtsa zhal mche bas ma mchu cang zad mnan zhing spyan gsum pa/ g.yas kyi phyag bzhis sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ pad+ma la gnas pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med dang*/ mda' dang*/ mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya/ g.yon gyi phyag bzhis sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang*/ gzhu dang*/ mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya dang*/ bum pa gang ba 'dzin pa/ lha'i na bza' dang rgyan gyis brgyan cing sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan nas mchod rten gyi phug gi nang rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/

spyi bo/ dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ lte ba/ rkang par/ oṃ hūm̐ traṃ hrīḥ.āḥrnams rim pa bzhin 'khod pa/ rigs bdag rnam snang ngo*// sngags ni/ oṃ bh+rūṃ swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 105 rnam par rgyal ma lha bdun ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad zla la bh+rūṃ dkar po las gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma zla ba lta bur dkar ba/ g.yas zhal ser po zhi ba/ g.yon zhal nag po khro ba/ rtsa zhal mche bas ma mchu cung zad mnan zhing spyan gsum pa/ g.yas kyi phyag bzhis sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ pad+ma la gnas pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med dang*/ mda' dang*/ mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya/ g.yon gyi phyag bzhis sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang*/ gzhu dang*/ mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya dang*/ bum pa gang ba 'dzin pa/ lha'i na bza' dang rgyan gyis brgyan cing sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan nas mchod rten gyi phug gi nang rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ spyi bo/ dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ lte ba/ rkang par/ oṃ hūm̐ traṃ hrīḥ.āḥ rnams rim pa bzhin 'khod pa/ g.yas su 'jig rten dbang phyug dkar po rnga yab dang pad+ma bsnams pa/ g.yon du phyag rdor sngon po rnga yab dang ut+pal la gnas pa'i rdo rje/ phyogs bzhir mi g.yo ba ral gri/ 'dod rgyal lcags kyu/ dbyug sngon can dbyug pa/ gnod mdzes rdo rje/ khro bo de thams cad sngon po/ g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag rnam snang ngo*// sngags ni/ oṃ bh+rūṃ swā hā/ zhes snying po dang*/ oṃ a mṛ ta ā yurda de swā hā/ zhes nye snying dang*/ oṃ ā mṛ te a mṛ totabha be a mṛ ta bi kran+te a mi ta gā te a mi ta ga mi ni a mi tā a yurda de ga ga na kirte ka re sarba ka le sha k+ṣa yaṃ ka re ye swā hā/ zhes 'phreng sngags dang*/ spro na rgyas pa gzungs ring bcas bzla'o// 106 gtsug tor gdugs dkar mo can gyi sgrub thabs ni/

pad zla la oṃ dkar po las gdugs dkar mo gzhan gyis mi thub ma/ g.yas sngo g.yon dmar dbus dkar ba'i zhal/ spyan gsum gsum mnga' ba/ phyag drug gi g.yas 'khor lo dang*/ lcags kyu/ gzhu/ g.yon rin po che dang*/ rdo rje'i zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub/ mda'/ khro mo'i nyams can gdon thams cad 'joms par mdzad ma/ lha'i na bza' dang rgyan gyis brgyan cing*/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan nas skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag bshad thag pa de'o// sngags ni/ oṃ si tā ta pa tra a ra dzi te sarba gra hā na trā sa ya trā sa ya ha na ha na druṃ druṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 107 phyir bzlog ma chen mo'i gtsug tor nag mo'i sgrub thabs ni/ hūm̐ las phyir zlog ma chen mo sku mdog nag mo/ zhal gcig phyag drug gi g.yas ral gri/ lcags kyu/ mchog sbyin/ g.yon pad dmar/ rtse gsum/ zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub thugs kar gnas pa/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan cing*/ rgyan thams cad kyis spras pa/ rigs bdag smos ma thag pa de'o// sngags ni/ oṃ si tā ta pā tre a ra dzi te sarba gra hā na trā ya trā sa ya ha na ha na druṃ druṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 108 gzhan gyis mi thub ma gtsug tor ser mo'i sgrub thabs ni/ skad cig gis gzhan gyis mi thub ma ser mo/ zhal gcig mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs par byed pa/ phyag gnyis kyi g.yas pas thal lcags brdeg pa'i tshul dang*/ g.yon zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub thugs kar gnas pa/ rin po che sna tshogs pas brgyan te tshogs bdag gi steng na bzhugs shing drag po'i lha rnams kyis bskor ba/ rigs bdag rnam snang ngo*/ sngags ni/ oṃ si tā ta pā tra a ra dzi te sarba gra hā na trā sa ya trā sa ya ha na ha na druṃ druṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 109 rdo rje tsar tsi ka'i sgrub thabs ni/ hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las rdo rje tsar tsi ka dmar mo/

zhal gcig mche ba gtsigs shing spyan gsum ma/ phyag drug gi g.yas na rdo rje/ ral gri/ 'khor lo/ g.yon thod pa/ nor bu/ chu skyes/ sku phung rid cing mi mgo'i 'phreng ba dang*/ phyag rgya dang stag sham gyis brgyan pa/ skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag mi bskyod pa'o// sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra tsartsi ke hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 110 so sor 'brang ma chen mo'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad zla la praṃ ser po las so sor 'brang ma sku mdog shin tu ser po/ rin 'byung dang rin po che'i cod pan can/ ser dkar sngo dmar ba'i zhal bzhi spyan gsum gsum mnga' ba/ phyag g.yas pa bzhis ral gri/ 'khor lo/ rtse gsum/ mda'/ g.yon pa bzhis zhags pa/ dgra sta/ rdo rje/ gzhu/ lang tshos snyem zhing rin po che'i rgyan dang lha'i na bza' 'dzin nas rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag rin 'byung ngo*// sngags ni/ oṃ ma ṇi dha ri badz+ri ṇi ma hā pra ti sa re hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/ zhes bzla/ yang na/ ser dkar dmar ba'i zhal zhes bsgyur khyad tsam ma gtogs gzhan sngar bzhin no// 111 rma bya chen mo'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad zla la māṃ ljang gu las rma bya chen mo sku mdog ljang khu/ ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas na rma bya'i sgro mdongs/ mda' dang*/ mchog sbyin/ g.yon na rin po che'i chun po/ gzhu dang*/ pad+ma la gnas pa'i bum pa/ rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan cing*/ gzhon nu rnam par sgeg ma skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs pa/ don grub kyis dbu brgyan pa/ rigs bdag de ka'o// sngags ni/ oṃ a mṛ ta bi lo ki garba saṃ rak+ṣa ṇi a kar+ṣa ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/ zhes sam/ yang na/ oṃ ma hā ma yū ri bid+yā rā dzñī hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 112 stong chen mo rab tu 'joms ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad zla la bh+rūṃ las stong chen rab tu 'joms ma sku mdog dmar mo/

zhal gcig phyag drug gi g.yas na ral gri/ mda'/ mchog sbyin/ g.yon na gzhu/ zhags pa/ dgra sta 'dzin pa/ rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan cing gzhon nu rnam par sgeg ma skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs shing rnam snang gis dbu brgyan pa/ rigs bdag de ka'o// sngags ni/ oṃ a mṛ ta pa re wa ra ba ra pra wa ra bi shud+dhe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 113 gsang sngags chen mo rjes su 'dzin ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad zla la hūm̐ las gsang sngags chen mo rjes su 'dzin ma sku mdog nag mo/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis rdo rje dang mchog sbyin/ g.yon gnyis zhags pa dang dgra sta/ rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan cing gzhon nu rnam par sgeg ma skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs shing mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa/ rigs bdag de'o// sngags ni/ oṃ bi mu le bi pu le dza ya wa re a mri te be ra dze hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 114 bsil ba'i tshal chen mo'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad zla la dzaṃ las bsil ba'i tshal chen mo sku mdog dmar mo/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas bgrang 'phreng dang mchog sbyin/ g.yon lcags kyu dang thugs kar po ti bsnams pa/ rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan cing gzhon nu rnam par sgeg ma skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag 'od dpag med do// sngags ni/ oṃ bha ra bha ra sam+bha ra sam+bha ra in+d+ra ni ya wa ya bi sho dha ni ru ru tsa la ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 115 so sor 'brang ma zhal gsum phyag bcu ma gtso bor byas pa'i bsrung ba lnga'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad zla la praṃ ser po las so sor 'brang ma sku mdog shin tu ser ba/ rin 'byung dang rin po che'i cod pan can/ ser nag dkar ba'i zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum mnga' ba/ phyag g.yas pa lngas ral gri/ rdo rje/ mda'/ mchog sbyin/ thugs kar gnas pa'i phyag gis mdung*/ g.yon pa lngas gzhu/ rgyal mtshan/ rin po che'i chun po/

dgra sta/ dung bsnams pa/ lang tshos snyem zhing rin po che'i rgyan dang lha'i na bza' 'dzin nas rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ pad zla la māṃ ljang khu las rma bya chen mo sku mdog ljang khu/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rma bya'i mdongs dang mchog sbyin/ rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan cing gzhon nu rnam par sgeg ma skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs shing don grub kyis dbu brgyan pa/ pad zla la bh+rūṃ las stong chen rab tu 'joms ma sku mdog dmar mo/ zhal gcig phyag drug gi g.yas pas ral gri/ mda'/ mchog sbyin/ g.yon pas gzhu/ zhags pa/ dgra sta 'dzin pa/ rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan cing gzhon nu rnam par sgeg ma skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs shing rnam snang gis dbu brgyan pa/ pad zla la hūm̐ las gsang sngags chen po rjes su 'dzin ma sku mdog nag mo/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas ral gri dang mchog sbyin/ g.yon zhags pa dang dgra sta/ rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan cing gzhon nu rnam par sgeg ma skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs shing mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa/ pad zla la dzaṃ las bsil ba'i tshal chen mo sku mdog dmar mo/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas ral gri dang mchog sbyin/ g.yon dgra sta dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan cing gzhon nu rnam par sgeg ma skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs zhing 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan pa rnams kyis bskor ba/ so so'i rigs bdag gong gsal ltar ro// so so 'brang ma'i sngags ni/ oṃ ma ṇi dha ri badz+ri ṇi ma hā pra ti sa re hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/ rma bya chen mo'i sngags ni/ oṃ a mṛ ta bi lo ki garba saṃ rak+ṣa ṇi a kar+ṣa ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/ zhes sam/ yang na/ oṃ ma hā ma yu ri bid+yā rā dzñī hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/ stong chen rab 'joms ma'i sngags ni/ oṃ a mṛ ta pa ri wā ra ba ra pra wa ra bi shud+dhe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/

gsang sngags rjes 'dzin ma'i sngags ni/ oṃ bi mu le bi pu le dza ye wa ra a mṛ te bi ra dze hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/ bsil ba'i tshal ma'i sngags ni/ oṃ bha ra bha ra sam+bha ra sam+bha ra in+d+ra ni ya wa ya bi sho dha ni ru ru tsa la ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/ zhes rim pas bzla'o// 116 srung ba lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs ni/ hūm̐ las rdo rje'i gur dang sa gzhi/ suṃ las thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su/ hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar praṃ gyis de bzhin gshegs pa lnga spyan drangs te thim pa las/ so sor 'brang ma chen mo sku mdog dkar mo/ spyi bor zla ba la mchod rten/ dkar nag ser dmar ba'i zhal bzhi/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yas na 'khor lo/ rdo rje/ mda'/ ral gri/ g.yon na rdo rje'i zhags pa/ rtse gsum/ gzhu/ dgra sta/ lang tshos snyem zhing rin po che'i rgyan dang lha'i na bza' 'dzin nas rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ byang chub kyi shing gis nye bar mdzes shing*/ shar du sna tshogs pad+mar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las stong chen rab 'joms nag mo khro mo/ thod pas brgyan cing rol pa'i stabs kyis 'byung po dang gnod sbyin chen po kun nas gnon pa/ rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ nag dkar ser ljang ba'i zhal bzhi/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yas bzhi mchog sbyin/ lcags kyu/ mda'/ ral gri/ g.yon bzhi sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ dgra sta/ gzhu/ pad+ma'i steng du rin po che cha drug pa/ lhor pad zla la māṃ las rma bya chen mo gser mdog can/ nyi ma la sems skyil gyis bzhugs pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ ser nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yas bzhi mchog sbyin/ bum pa/ 'khor lo/ ral gri/ g.yon bzhi lhung bzed steng na dge slong*/ rma bya'i mdongs/ bum pa'i steng na sna tshogs rdo rje/ rin po che'i rgyal mtshan/ nub tu pad zla la māṃ las gsang sngags rjes su 'dzin ma dkar mo/

rgyan dang shrī ri pa'i shing gis mdzes pa/ dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag bcu gnyis kyi dang po gnyis chos kyi 'khor lo/ gnyis pa gnyis ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya/ g.yas pa'i lhag mas mchog sbyin/ mi 'jigs pa/ rdo rje/ mda'/ g.yon pa'i lhag mas sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ mda'/ rin po che'i dog pa/ pad+ma/ byang du pad zlar tāṃ las bsil ba'i tshal ma sku mdog ljang khu/ rgyan gyis brgyan te g.yas brkyang gis nyi ma la bzhugs pa/ ljang dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum mi 'jigs pa/ rdo rje/ mda'/ g.yon rnams rin po che'i rgyal mtshan/ zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub/ gzhu 'dzin pa/ de rnams kyis bskor ba/ rigs bdag dbus la rnam snang*/ shar du mi bskyod pa/ lhor rin byung*/ nub tu 'od dpag med/ byang du don grub bo// so sor 'brang ma'i sngags ni/ oṃ ma ṇi dha ri badz+ri ṇi ma hā pra ti sa re hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/ stong chen mo'i sngags ni/ oṃ a mṛ ta pa re wa ra ba ra pra wa ra bi shud+dhe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/ rma bya chen mo'i sngags ni/

oṃ a mṛ ta bi lo ki ṇi gar+bha saṃ rak+ṣa ni a kar+ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/ gsang sngags rjes 'dzin ma'i sngags ni/ oṃ bi mu le bi pu la dza ye wa ra a mṛ te bi ra dze hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/ bsil tshal ma'i sngags ni/ oṃ bha ra bha ra sam+bha ra sam+bha ra in+d+ra ni ya wa ya bi sho dha ni ru ru tsa la ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ zhes rim pas bzla'o// 117 rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan gyi sgrub thabs ni/ pad nyi la hūm̐ las rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan nag mo/ nag dmar ljang ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas ral gri dang zhags pa/ g.yon rdo rje'i kha ṭ+wāṃ dang 'khor lo/ thod pa lnga dang mi bskyod pa'i cod pan gyis dbu brgyan pa/ stod g.yogs ser po dang stag sham can/ mche ba gtsigs shing lto ba 'phyang ba/ nyi ma la g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag mi bskyod pa'o// sngags ni/ oṃ sarba grah+ṇa k+ṣe ṭa dh+ya mi ka ra ṇi swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 118 rgyal mtshan rtse mo zhal bzhi phyag bzhi ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad nyi la dh+wa ser mo las g.yul las rgyal bar byed pa'i lha mo gser mdog ma/ ser dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum dang steng zhal dud kha/ phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis ral gri dang*/ sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i rdo rje'i zhags pa/ 'og ma gnyis 'khor lo dang*/ rdo rje mtshan pa'i gtun shing dkar po/ g.yon du rtse gsum la 'khyud pa/ ral pa dmar ser gyen du brdzes shing bcings pa/ thod pa lnga dang mi bskyod pa'i cod pan gyis dbu brgyan pa/ stod g.yogs ser po dang stag sham can/ mche ba gtsigs shing lto ba 'phyang ba/ nyi ma la g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag mi bskyod pa'o// sngags ni/ oṃ sarba grah+ṇa k+ṣe ṭa dh+yā mi ka ra ṇi swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 119 rdo rje gan+dha ri'i sgrub thabs ni/ skad cig gis rdo rje gan+dhā ri sku mdog nag mo/ nag dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i zhal drug

phyag bcu gnyis kyi g.yas pas rdo rje/ dril bu/ ral gri/ tri shu la/ mda'/ 'khor lo bsnams pa/ g.yon pas kha ṭ+wāṃ ga lcags kyu/ gzhu/ dgra sta/ zhags pa/ snying gar sdigs mdzub/ zhabs g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag mi bskyod pa'o// sngags ni/ oṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 120 rdo rje lcags sgrog ma zhal gsum phyag drug ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad zla'i gdan la hūm̐ ljang ga las rdo rje lcags sgrog ma sku mdog ljang ga ljang sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum bzhad cing*/ spyan gsum pa/ phyag drug gi g.yas na rdo rje/ lcags sgrog mda'/ g.yon pa sdigs mdzub/ zhags pa/ gzhu/ rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag don grub bo// sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra shrī kha le hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 121 rdo rje lcags sgrog ma zhal gsum phyag brgyad ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ sna tshogs pad nyi la hūm̐ ljang ser las rdo rje lcags sgrog ma ljang gu zhal dang po bzhad pa/ g.yas ser skya spyan ser skya dang ldan pa/ g.yon dmar zhing khro ba/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yas bzhi mi 'jigs pa dang*/ rdo rje/ lcags sgrog mda'/ g.yon bzhi khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ sdigs mdzub/ zhags pa/ gzhu/ rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ byi ba'i pags pas stod g.yogs byas shing don grub kyis dbu brgyan pa/ rigs bdag de'o// sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra shrī kha le hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 122 nor rgyun ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad zla la baṃ las nor rgyun ma sku mdog gser lta bu/ nor sbyin gyi bu mo brgyad gnyis lon pa'i byin dang ldan pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon 'bras kyi snye ma bsnams pa/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan cing skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs pa/ mdun du dpal gyi nor/ g.yas su nor ster ma/ rgyab tu dpal gyi nor/ g.yon du nor bu'i blo brtan ma/ de thams cad gtso mo dang mtshungs pa/

rigs bdag mi bskyod pa'o// sngags ni/ oṃ ba su dhā rī ṇi swā hā/ oṃ shrī ba su ni swā hā/ oṃ ba su shrī ye swā hā/ oṃ shrī bā su mu khi swā hā/ oṃ ba su shrī ye swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 123 yang nor rgyun ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad zla la baṃ las nor rgyun ma sku mdog gser lta bu/ nor sbyin gyi bu mo brgyad gnyis lon pa'i byin dang ldan pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon 'bru'i snye ma dang rin po che sna tshogs pa'i char 'bab bzhin pa'i bum pa bsnams pa/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan te skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs pa/ mdun du dpal gyi nor/ g.yas su nor ster ma/ rgyab tu dpal gyi nor/ g.yon du nor bu'i blo brtan ma/ de thams cad gtso mo dang mtshungs pa/ rigs bdag mi bskyod pa'o// sngags ni/ oṃ ba su dha ri ni k+ṣe ṭe swā hā/ zhes sam/ yang na/ oṃ ba su dha ra rat+na ni dhā na k+ṣe tre swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 124 rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub thabs ni/ nam mkha' la yaṃ raṃ baṃ laṃ las 'byung bzhi/ suṃ las ri rab/ hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa gur dang bcas pa'i nang du gzhal yas khang gi nang*/ paṃ las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa la/ ā li las zla ba dang kā li las nyi ma kha sbyar ba'i nang du/ rdo rje baṃ gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo 'char ka'i kha dog can/ phyag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub/ g.yon thod pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ gru mo g.yon kha ṭ+wāṃ ga la brten cing*/ zhal gcig khro 'dzum spyan gsum mnga' ba/ skra grol ba phyag rgya drug dang thod skam gyis dbu brgyan cing mgo rlon gyi do shal 'phyang ba/ gcer mo lhan cig skyes dga'i rang bzhin gyi lang tsho rgyas pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang gis 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan ma mnan pa/ shar du mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/ byang du lā ma ljang khu/

nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo/ de rnams zhal gcig phyag bzhis gri gug dang*/ ḍā ma ru dang*/ thod pa dang*/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing gcer mo g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ mtshams la byang chub sems sogs bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa/ lte bar oṃ baṃ/ snying gar haṃ yoṃ/ mgrin par hrī moṃ/ dpral bar hriṃ hriṃ/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭ phaṭ/ sked par oṃ hūm̐ khaṃ aṃ traṃ bh+rūṃ rnams kyis mtshan pa/ rigs bdag rnam snang ngo*// sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa na nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 125 phag dkar shes rab gsal byed kyi sgrub thabs ni/ paṃ dmar po las pad+ma/ aṃ las skyes pa'i nyi mar hūm̐ yig dkar po las/ nyi ma la hrīḥdakar pos mtshan pa'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa dmar po/ de'i 'od kyis don gnyis mdzad de nyi ma la zhugs pa rnams yongs su gyur pa'i phag mo shes rab gsal byed/ mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa/ spyan gsum dmar zhing sgeg pa la sogs pa'i nyams dang nu 'bur rgyas pa/ phyag g.yas ba dan dang bcas pa'i rdo rje 'og tu bsnun zhing*/ khrag gis gang ba'i pad+ma'i snod zhal gyen du phyogs pas 'thung zhing*/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dkar po rtse mo gcig pa g.yon pa'i phrag par bkal ba/ dbu skra phyed bcings pa la sna tshogs pa'i me tog gis mdzes shing*/ rdo rje nag po'i 'phreng ba gnyis kyi dbus su thod 'phreng dang zur phud gsum bcings pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing mgo rlon lnga bcu do shal du byas pa/ gcer mo g.yas brkyang gis nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ nyi ma'i 'od lta bur rab tu 'phro ba'i sprul pa sna tshogs pas phyogs bcur 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa/ snying gar nyi ma la hrīḥlas rdo rje'i lte ba la rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa'/ de yi 'od kyis khams gsum gzugs su sbyangs te bsdus nas de la thim/

de'i snying gar sna tshogs pad+mar nyi ma dkar dmar la hrīḥdakar po/ de la sngags kyis bskor ba/ de las sngags 'phreng 'khor ba zhal nas 'thon/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi shes rab kyi snang ba skyed pa'i mthu thams cad bsdus te/ lte ba'i bu ga nas rab tu zhugs te mi shes pa'i mun pa bsreg par bsgom/ rigs bdag mi bskyod pa'o// sngags ni/ hrīḥ zhes bzla'o// 126 rdo rje phag mo dbang du bya ba'i sgrub thabs ni/ baṃ las rdo rje phag mo spyan drangs te de la thim pa yongs su gyur pa'i zla ba dmar po baṃ gyis mtshan pa las/ bcom ldan 'das ma sku mdog dmar mo phyag g.yas ut+pal dmar po kha ma bye ba'i rdo rje'i lcags kyu lta bu/ g.yon hrīḥyig gi zhags pa bsnams pa/ des khams gsum gyi bsgrub bya thams cad zhags pas bcings shing lcags kyus bskul te rang gi sems la zhugs/ de nas lte bar rdo rje phag mo gri gug dang thod pa bsnams te gar mdzad pa/ rigs bdag rdo rje sems dpa'o// sngags ni/ oṃ āḥ.a mu ka s+ya tsa tsit+ta mā ka tra ya hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes bzla'o// 127 rdo rje phag mo don thams cad grub pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ lte bar raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum/ de'i dbus su pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa/ de'i dbus su suṃ 'bar ba las/ rdo rje phag mo don thams cad grub ma sku mdog dmar mo gcer bu zhal gcig spyan gsum khros pa/ dbu skra gyen du brdzes pa thod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis rdo rje dang lcags kyu/ g.yon gnyis thod pa dang zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub/ gru mor kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ ri dwags kyi gdan la g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa la/ mtshams kyi 'dab mar bdud rtsis gang ba'i pad+ma'i snod/ phyogs bzhir rdo rje sna ma dang*/ shin tu 'jigs byed ma dang*/ lto chen ma dang*/ ljags bskyod ma gri thod 'dzin pas bskor ba/ rigs bdag rdo rje sems dpa'o// sngags ni/

oṃ badz+ra wā rā hī ā be sha ya sarba duṣ+ṭan hrīḥswā hā/ zhes nye snying dang*/ oṃ hūm̐ hriṃḥhriṃḥ zhes snying po bzla'o// 128 mgon po byams pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la maiṃ las mgon po byams pa sku mdog gser lta bu/ ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag dang po gnyis chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya/ lhag ma gnyis mchog sbyin dang nā ga ge sar gyi me tog gi snye ma bsnams pa/ sna tshogs pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag rdo rje sems dpa'o// sngags ni/ oṃ mai tri ye swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 129 khro zhing dgyes pa dzam+bha la'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad zla la rdo rje hūm̐ nag pos mtshan pa/ oṃ āḥsangs rgyas thams cad dzam+bha la'i rnam pas de la thim pa las/ dzam+bha la nag po lo lnga lon pa'i byis pa lta bu/ rtags bsgreng zhing lto ba 'phyang ba gel ba/ klu la sogs pa'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing*/ phyag g.yas pas thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pa la zhal mngon par phyogs pa/ phyag g.yon pas brla'i steng du rin po che skyug bzhin pa'i ne'u le kha thur du bstan te bsnams pa/ shin tu khros pa'i gnod sbyin ser po gan rkyal du bsgyel ba'i khar g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ thub pa mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa/ dpral ba/ dpung pa gnyis/ snying khar rdo rje'i steng*/ brla gnyis/ zhabs gnyis/ bshang gci'i bu gar zla ba la/ oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+d+d+ra ye swā hā/ zhes rim pa bzhin gnas pa/ rlung phyir 'phro ba hūm̐ gi rnam pas sems can thams cad bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi skur byas/ tshur rngub dus des 'jig rten gyi khams kyi nor bu thams cad klu dang ne'u le dang gnod sbyin gyi khar bcug slar dbyung ba na/ de rnams kyi kha nas skyugs pas 'dod dgu mi zad par 'phel bar bsam pa/ rigs bdag mi bskyod pa'o// sngags ni/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/

na mo ma ṇi bha dra ya/ ma hā yak+ṣa se na pā ta ye/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+d+ra ye swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 130 dzam+bha la ser po lha dgu yum can gyi sgrub thabs ni/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad lte ba dang dgu la dzaṃ dgu baṃ dgu las/ dbus su dzam+bha la sku mdog gser lta bu/ sku thung zhing lhu lag rags pa/ lto ba 'phyang ba/ phyag g.yas na bi dza pū rā ka dang*/ phyag g.yon na rin po che'i char 'bebs bzhin pa'i ne'u le bsnams pa/ sangs rgyas lnga'i cod pan can/ zhabs gnyis kyis dung gi mgo dang*/ pad+ma'i mgo'i gter bdag chen po dag mnan nas rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ ut+pal sngon po dang rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa dang lhan cig tu/ nor rgyun ma sku mdog gser lta bu/ nor sbyin gyi bu mo brgyad gnyis lon pa'i byin dang ldan pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon 'bras kyi snye ma bsnams pa/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa/ skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs pa/ shar lho nub byang du nor bu bzang po/ gang ba bzang po/ nor sbyin/ rnam sras/ me srin rlung*/ dbang ldan du ki li mi li/ pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa li/ mu khen+d+ra/ tsa ren+d+ra/ de rnams dang rim pa bzhin/ chu shel ma/ so legs ma/ 'phags ma/ shin tu bzang mo/ rab tu dga' ma/ sbas ma/ lha mo/ dbyangs can ma rnams lhan cig par gtso bo yab yum ji lta ba/ rigs bdag rin 'byung ngo*// sngags ni/ oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+d+ra ye swā hā/ oṃ ma ṇi bha drā ye swā hā/ oṃ pur+ṇa bha drā ye swā hā/ oṃ dhā na dā ya swā hā/ oṃ bai shra ba ṇā ye swā hā/ oṃ ki li mi li ni swā hā/ oṃ pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa li ni swā hā/ oṃ mu khen+d+ra ya swā hā/ oṃ ba su dhā ri ṇi swā hā/ oṃ tsan+d+ra kan+t+yai swā hā/ oṃ dat+tā yai swā hā/ oṃ su dat+tā yai swā hā/ oṃ ār+yā yai swā hā/ oṃ su bha drā yai swā hā/ oṃ gup+tā+e yai swā hā/ oṃ de wi yai swā hā/

oṃ swa ra swa t+yai swā hā/ zhes pa rnams bzla'o// 131 nor rgyun ma lha mang gi sgrub thabs ni/ khang pa brtsegs ma'i dbus su cung zad dma' ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ nor sbyin gyi shing rta zur gsum pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i rnam pa/ de'i dbus su baṃ las nor rgyun ma sku mdog gser lta bu/ nor sbyin gyi bu mo brgyad gnyis lon pa'i byin dang ldan pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon 'bras kyi snye ma bsnams pa mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa/ skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs pa/ bzang mo dang*/ rab tu bzang mo dang*/ rab tu dga' ma dang*/ sbas ma dang*/ lha mo dang*/ dbyangs can ma dang*/ 'phags ma dang*/ chu shel ma rnams gtso mo nyid lta bu'i rnam pas bskor ba/ lha mo de'i bha ga'i dbus su/ dzaṃ yig las skyes pa'i dzam+bha la nor rgyun ma la 'khyud pa/ byang chub kyi sems nges par sbyor ba'i rin po che phyag na yang dag par gtod pa/ lha mo gzhan brgyad kyi nyer gnas kyi dbus su/ nor bzang sogs brgyad phyogs kyi mdog can rang rang gi dga' ma la 'khyud pa/ shar sgor nor sbyin dang nor sbyin chen mo/ lho sgor gnod sbyin dang gnod sbyin chen mo/ nub sgor ki li mi li dang ki li mi li chen mo/ byang sgor gang ba bzang po dang gang ba bzang mo/ de thams cad gcer bu rtags bsgreng shing 'bras bu dang lto ba 'phyang ba/ rin po che'i char 'bebs pa'o// spyi bo dang mdzub mor nor bzang*/ nu bar dang gung mor gang bzang*/ ming med dang lte bar nor sbyin/ mig gnyis dang the'u chung la rnam sras/ kha la mu khen+d+ra/ rkang pa dang mtheb chen la pi tsi kun+ḍa li/ brla dang mkhrig mar ki li mi li/ yan lag thams cad la tsa ren+d+ra'o/ dpyi/ dpral ba/ rna ba/ ltag pa/ mkhrig ma/ mgul pa/ lag pa'i dbus rnams su/ oṃ dzaṃlu ts+luṃ swā hā/ ts+luṃ sluṃ swā hā/ sor mo rnams la/ oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+d+ra ye swā hā/
oṃ dzaṃlu ts+luṃ swā hā/ 'khod pa/

rigs bdag mi bskyod pa'o// sngags ni/ oṃ ba su dhā ri ṇi swā hā/ oṃ tsan+d+ra kan+t+yai swā hā/ oṃ dat+ta yai swā hā/ oṃ su dat+ta yai swā hā/ oṃ ār+ya yai swā hā/ oṃ su dra yai swā hā/ oṃ gup+te yai swā hā/ oṃ de wi swā hā/ oṃ swa ra swa t+ye swā hā/ oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+d+ra ye swā hā/ oṃ ma ṇi bha dra ya swā hā/ oṃ pur+ṇa bha dra ya swā hā/ oṃ dha na dā ye swā hā/ oṃ bai shra pa ṇā ya swā hā/ oṃ ki li mi li swā hā/ oṃ pi tsi kun+ḍa li ni swā hā/ oṃ mu khen+d+ra ye swā hā/ oṃ tsa ren+d+ra ya swā hā/ zhes pa rnams bzla'o// 132 dzam+bha la ser po zhal gsum phyag drug ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad zla la dzaṃ las dzam+bha la ser po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ g.yas ma du lu ga dang*/ lcags kyu dang*/ mda'/ g.yon rtsibs logs g.yon du gnas pa'i shes rab ma la 'khyud pas zhags pa dang*/ ne'u le dang*/ gzhu bkang ba/ rgyan gyis brgyan te mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa/ rigs bdag de ka'o// sngags ni/ oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+d+ra ye swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 133 dzaṃ ser phyag gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad zla la dzaṃ las dzam+bha la sku mdog gser lta bu/ sku thung zhing lhu lag rags pa/ lto ba 'phyang ba/ phyag g.yas na bi dzu pū rā ka dang*/ phyag g.yon na rin po che'i char 'bebs bzhin pa'i ne'u le bsnams pa/ sangs rgyas lnga'i cod pan can/ zhabs gnyis dung gi mgo dang*/ pad+ma'i mgo'i gter chen po dag mnan nas rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ ut+pal sngon po dang rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ rigs bdag rin 'byung ngo*// sngags ni/ oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+d+ra ye swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 134 rta mgrin zhal gsum phyag brgyad ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad nyi la haṃ dmar po las bcom ldan 'das h+ya gṝ wa sku mdog dang rtsa zhal dmar po bzhad pa/ g.yas sngon po ljags 'dril ba/ g.yon dkar po mche bas ma mchu mnan pa/

phyag brgyad kyi g.yas rdo rje/ dbyug pa/ mchog sbyin/ mda'/ g.yon sdigs mdzub rang gi nu mar 'dzin pa dang*/ pad+ma/ gzhu/ khro bo chen po mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan cing*/ stag sham dang sbrul gyi rgyan bzung ste rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag mi bskyod pa'o// sngags ni/ oṃ haṃ h+ya gṛ wa swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 135 rtogs pa bdun pa las gsungs pa'i rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs ni/ nyi ma la hūm̐ gi 'od kyis sangs rgyas thams cad bsdus te de nyid la thim pa las/ bcom ldan 'das rta mgrin sku mdog dmar po shin tu 'jigs su rung ba'i khro bo'i zhal dang*/ steng du rta zhal ljang zhur/ hi hi'i sgra mi bzad par sgrog pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje'i dbyug pa 'phyar zhing g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub/ klu brgyad dang stag sham gyis spras te mi'u thung gi rnam pas g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag 'od dpag med do// sngags ni/ oṃ h+ya gṝ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces bzla'o// 136 rgyud thams cad kyi snying po phyi ma'i rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs ni/ pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i lte bar zla gdan la/ hūm̐ las bcom ldan 'das rta mgrin dmar po/ dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum dang steng du rta zhal ljang khu/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yas bzhi lcags kyu/ mda'/ thod pa/ rdo rje/ g.yon bzhi zhags pa/ gzhu/ kha ṭ+wāṃ/ dril bu/ rgyan thams cad kyis brjid pa thod pa'i 'phreng ba can/ zhabs bzhi g.yas brkyang g.yon brkyang gnyis ka'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ shar du hrīḥlas rdo rje 'jigs chen ma sna tshogs mdog rta'i gdong ma/ phyag bzhi g.yas pa mda' dang keng rus/ g.yon gzhu dang bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa/ sna tshogs pa'i gzugs can/ lhor haṃ las 'bar ba chen mo nag mo phag gdong ma/ phyag bzhir zhags pa dang keng rus/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang thod khrag thod pa la gnas pa nag po/ nub tu hrīḥlas rdo rje ma ser mo ce spyang gdong ma/

phyag bzhir ḍā ma ru dang keng rus/ rgyal mtshan dang dri chen gyi thod pa/ byang du hrīḥlas rdo rje lag ma dkar mo glang po'i gdong ma/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas rdo rje dang keṃ rus/ g.yon zhags pa dang dri chu'i thod pa/ de thams cad khro mo g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag rdo rje sems dpa'o// sngags ni/ oṃ h+ya gṝ wa hrīḥ a haṃ a haṃ/ aṃ aṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 137 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i sgrub thabs ni/ hūm̐ nag po las khro bo chen po 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba sku mdog mthing nag zhal dang po khro zhing sgeg pa/ g.yas drag po/ g.yon rnam par 'jigs pa/ rgyab zhal dpa' ba ste/ phyag brgyad kyi dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dril bur bcas pas thugs kar hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ lhag ma'i g.yas gsum ral gri/ lcags kyu/ mda'/ g.yon mas rim gyis gzhu/ zhags pa/ rdo rje/ zhabs g.yon brkyang gis dbang phyug chen po'i mgo dang*/ g.yas kyis gau ri'i nu ma zung mnan pa/ sna tshogs pa'i rgyan dang na bza' can/ rigs bdag mi bskyod pa'o// sngags ni/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐/ gṛ h+ṇa gṛ h+ṇa hūm̐/ gṛ h+ṇa pa ya gṛ h+ṇa pa ya hūm̐/ a na ya hoḥbha ga wan bid+yā rā dza hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces bzla'o// 138 rdo rje me dang nyi ma 'bar ba'i sgrub thabs ni/ hūm̐ mthing kha las rdo rje me dang nyi ma 'bar ba sku mdog mthing kha/ sgeg pa 'jigs pa snying rje'i nyams dang ldan pa'i zhal bzhi/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yas bzhir rdo rje/ ral gri/ 'khor lo/ mda'/ g.yon bzhir dril bu/ zhags pa/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga gzhu/ chung ma dang bcas pa'i khyab 'jug g.yas brkyang gis mnan nas sbrul la sogs pas brgyan te bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag mi bskyod pa'o// sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa lā na larka hūm̐/ zhes bzla'o// 139 rta mchog gi sgrub thabs ni/ hūm̐ mthing ga las rdo rje rta mchog dmar po/ zhal dang po khro zhing sgeg pa/

g.yas zhal nag po/ g.yon zhal 'jigs su rung ba/ steng rta zhal ljang zhur/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yas bzhir rdo rje/ ba dan/ ral gri/ mda'/ g.yon bzhir ral gri dang bcas pa'i pad+ma/ mdung*/ dbyug pa/ gzhu/ g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa'am/ zhabs bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis dbang mo dang dpal mo/ 'dod lha dang 'dod lha'i chung ma/ g.yon gnyis kyis dbang po dang sbrang rtsir byed pa/ rgyal byed dang dpyod byed mnan pa/ rigs bdag rdo rje sems dpa'o// sngags ni/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐/ zhes bzla'o// 140 gshin rje gshed dmar po'i sgrub thabs ni/ a las nyi ma/ de'i steng du hūm̐ dmar po las mgo rlon gyis brgyan pa'i dbyug pa dkar po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las gshin rje gshed sku mdog dmar po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis thung zhing gel pa/ phyag g.yas mgo bos mtshan pa'i dbyug pa dkar po 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pas rang 'od kyi shes rab ma la 'khyud pa/ sbrul gyis brgyan pa 'jigs su rung ba/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ g.yon brkyang gis ma he'i steng du bzhugs pa/ thugs kar nyi ma la hūm̐ las byung ba'i dbyug tho dkar po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ gsang ba'i rdo rjer hūm̐ dang*/ shes rab ma'i gsang bar a las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad par so so'i sa bon gyis mtshan pa/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ lte 'og tu chu skyes dmar po'i steng du hrīḥ shes rab ma'i gsang bar a las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad par so so'i sa bon gyis mtshan pa/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga na badz+ra swa bhā wa a bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ lte 'og tu chu skyes dmar po'i steng du hrīḥ rigs bdag mi bskyod pa'o// sngags ni/ oṃ hrīṣ+ṭī wi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/ oṃ ya man+ta ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces bzla'o// 141 gshin rje gshed nag po'i sgrub thabs ni/

aṃ las nyi ma de'i steng du hūm̐ nag po las rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa nag po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ gshin rje gshed sku mdog nag po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis thung zhing gel ba/ phyag g.yas kyis rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa mthing nag 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ sbrul gyis brgyan cing 'jigs su rung ba/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ g.yon brkyang gis ma he'i steng du bzhugs pa/ thugs kar nyi ma la hūm̐ las byung ba'i dbyug tho mthing ga hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ rigs bdag mi bskyod pa'o// sngags ni/ oṃ hrīṣ+ṭī wi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/ oṃ ya man+ta ka hūm̐/ zhes bzla'o// 142 gshin rje dgra nag gi sgrub thabs ni/ hūm̐ mthing nag las shin tu zhud pa'i gshin rje nag po/ zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na rdo rje/ ral gri/ gtun shing*/ g.yon pa gsum na ro langs/ dgra sta/ zhags pa bsnams pa/ khro bo'i byin chen po dang ldan zhing mi'u thung lta bu/ thod pa dang klu brgyad dang stag lpags kyis spras pa/ g.yon brkyang gis ma he'i steng du me dpung 'bar ba'i 'phreng bas dkrigs te bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag mi bskyod pa'o// sngags ni/ oṃ hrīṣ+ṭī wi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/ zhes bzla/ yang na g.yas dang po 'khor lo zhes kyang ngo*// 143 gshin rje gdong drug gi sgrub thabs ni/ yaṃ las stong nyid raṃ las nyi ma hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i gur gyi dbus su/ zla bar dbyangs so gnyis/ nyi mar gsal byed brgyad cus mtshan pa/ de gnyis yongs su gyur pa'i hūm̐ dang yaṃ las/ bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed char sprin nag po'i kha dog can/ rang gi sku'i 'od kyis khro bo lnga 'phro zhing*/ zhal drug gi dang po nag po/ lhag ma mthing dkar ser dmar nag pa/ zlum zhing dmar ba'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/

mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ smin ma dang sma ra me ltar 'bar ba/ phyag drug gi g.yas tho ba/ ral gri/ rdo rje/ g.yon gsum ka sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ gdengs can dang thod pa'i cod pan/ dregs pa'i mgo dang glang chen mi lpags la sogs pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs drug gi gnyis g.yon brkyang*/ gzhan pa gnyis gar stabs/ lhag ma sems skyil gyis ma he la bzhugs pa/ mig rna ba/ sna/ lce/ nu ma/ lte bar/ k+ṣiṃ baṃ khaṃ laṃ kaṃ saṃ las/ sa snying*/ nam snying*/ phyag rdor/ 'jig rten dbang phyug sgrib sel/ kun bzang*/ rim pa bzhin/ 'khor lo/ rdo rje/ rin chen/ pad+ma/ mda'/ rdo rje rnams g.yas su 'dzin cing*/ g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ dkar nag ser dmar ljang dmar ba/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ las gnas gsum sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje dkar dmar nag pa'i 'khor lo chu skyes rdo rje/ g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ rigs bdag mi bskyod pa'o// sngags ni/ oṃ hrīṣ+ṭī wi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 144 khro bo bgegs mthar byed kyi sgrub thabs ni/ aṃ las nyi ma hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las/ khro bo bgegs mthar byed sku mdog mthing ga zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje 'phyar zhing g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub dang bcas pas zhags pa 'dzin pa/ klu dang stag lpags kyis spras pa g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag mi bskyod pa'o// sngags ni/ oṃ āḥbigh+nan+ta kṛta hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces bzla'o// 145 rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad kyi sgrub thabs ni/ raṃ las nyi ma la hūm̐ las drag po chen po khams gsum za bar mdzad pa nag po nyi ma'i 'od can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu rab tu sbyor ba'i phyag rgya thugs kar bcings pa/ g.yon brkyang gis 'jigs byed mnan cing 'jigs par byed pa'i rgyan can/ rigs bdag mi bskyod pa'o// sngags ni/ oṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/

zhes bzla'o// 146 stobs po che'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad dkar nyi mar hūm̐ las stobs po che sku mdog dmar po nyi ma'i 'od can/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas dbyug pa dang rnga yab/ g.yon phyag 'tshal ba'i tshul dang sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan cing*/ stag sham can g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag 'od dpag med do// sngags ni/ oṃ ma hā ba la swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 147 he ru ka phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ dur khrod brgyad kyi dbus su ā li kā li las zla nyi kha sbyar ba'i lte bar hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa rnams yongs su gyur pa'i he ru ka sku mdog sngon po drang srong khros pa'i nyams can/ rdo rje g.yas dang*/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ba dan gyis mdzes pa can g.yon pa'i mchan khung du bcangs shing thod pa dmar po bsnams pa/ skam pa'i cod pan dang rlon pa'i do shal/ phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ glang po che dang stag gi pags pa bgos te skyil krung phyed pas/ mi lpags dang rdo rje'i gdan la g.yas pa ro'i khar bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag mi bskyod pa'o// sngags ni/ oṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 148 dgyes pa rdo rje phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ nyi ma la hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa'i dgyes pa rdo rje sku mdog nag po drang srong khros pa'i nyams can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa rdo rje dang des mtshan pa'i thod pa 'dzin pa/ gri gug dang thod pa can gyi bdag med ma la 'khyud pa/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang*/ phyag rgya drug dang ldan pa/ stag sham can skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis ro'i steng nyi ma la bzhugs pa/ rna ba mig sna lce lus yid la rim pa bzhin/ bdag med ma/ rdo rje ma/ gau rī ma/ chu'i rnal 'byor ma/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ bdag med ma/ spyi bor haṃ/ mgrin par yaṃ/ snying gar hūm̐/ lte bar aṃ/ rigs bdag mi bskyod pa'o// sngags ni/

oṃ trai lo kya k+ṣe pa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 149 bdag med ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ zla ba la māṃ sngon po las bcom ldan 'das bdag med ma sku mdog nag mo/ zhal gcig mche ba gtsigs shing ljags bskyod pa/ 'bar ba'i spyan gsum pa/ ral pa ser po gyen du brdzes pa la mi bskyod pas mdzes pa/ phyag g.yas gri gug dang*/ g.yon thod pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag mi bskyod pa'o// sngags ni/ oṃ/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// 150 phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed kyi sgrub thabs ni/ hūm̐ 'khor ba'i zla ba las sna tshogs chu skyes kyi dbus su oṃ yig las sman gyi dbang po ste/ hūm̐ yongs su gyur pa'i rdo rje mthing nag las/ khro bo'i rgyal po 'byung po 'dul byed kha dog nag po 'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrigs pa gtum po chen po khams gsum za bar mdzad pa/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas rdo rje dang ḍā ma ru/ g.yon zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub dang*/ rtse gsum mchan dang*/ thod pa bsnams pa/ 'jigs par byed pa'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing*/ na bza' sngon po dang stag gi sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yon brkyang gis 'byung po gzhan gyis mi thub pa mnan te bzhugs pa/

rigs bdag mi bskyod pa'o// sngags ni/ hūm̐ badz+ra phaṭḥ ces bzla'o// 151 yang 'byung po 'dul byed kyi sgrub thabs ni/ hūm̐ 'khor ba'i zla ba las sna tshogs chu skyes kyi dbus su oṃ yig las sman gyi dbang po ste/ hūm̐ yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje mthing nag rtse lnga pa/ de las khro bo'i rgyal po 'byung po 'dul byed kha dog nag po 'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrigs pa gtum po chen po khams gsum za bar mdzad pa/ rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis kyis 'byung po 'dul byed kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyis rdo rje dang*/ zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ 'jigs par byed pa'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing*/ na bza' sngon po dang stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yon brkyang gis 'byung po gzhan gyis mi thub pa mnan te bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag mi bskyod pa'o// sngags ni/ hūm̐ badz+ra phaṭḥ ces bzla'o// 152 nag po chen po phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ sna tshogs pad nyi la hūm̐ nag po las nag po chen po zhal gcig pa mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs par byed pa/ 'bar ba chen po'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ smin ma ag tshom dang skra thams cad ser po/ dur khrod kyi chas kyis spras pa/ g.yas gri gug 'phyar zhing g.yon thugs kar thod khrag 'dzin pa/ mi'u thung gel ba lta bu g.yon brkyangs nas ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag mi bskyod pa'o// sngags ni/ oṃ ma hā kā la ya/ sha sa na u pa ha ri ṇi/ e ṣa a pash+tsi ma kā lo a yaṃ/ i dam rat+na tra yā ya/ a pa kā ri ṇaṃ/ ya di pra tī dzñā smra si ta da/ i daṃ duṣ+ṭaṃ sa twa na/ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ma ra ma ra/ gṛ h+na gṛ h+ṇa/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ dī na me ki na mā ra ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ/ hūm̐ phaṭ hūm̐/ zhes bzla'o// 153 nag po chen po phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad+ma la a las zla ba/ de'i steng du hūm̐ dkar po las ral gri/

de'i khar yang zla ba la hūm̐/ de thams cad yongs su gyur pa'i dpal ye shes kyi mgon po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa shin tu 'jigs pa'i byad bzhin can/ g.yas ral gri dang mchog sbyin/ g.yon rtse gsum dang thod pa/ dpa' zhing sgeg pa drag shul chen po'i sku/ dpa' bo chen po'i chas thams cad kyi spras te nyin mor byed pa'i snang ba dang ldan pas/ sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bam chen po'i steng du bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag rdo rje sems dpa'o// sngags ni/ oṃ aṃ maṃ hraṃ raṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces bzla bar bya'o// de yang lha sngags gcig la sgrub thabs so so bar mdzad pa po mi gcig pas bkod pa dang*/ yang lha mthun la sngags mi mthun nas sngags gnyis su bsdebs/ lha mdog 'khor zhal phyag gi khyad par med la phyag mtshan khyad yod pas yang na bar bkod/ sgrub thabs so sor dgos pa rkang grangs 'di tsam mo// zhes kun mkhyen pad+ma dkar pos bzhed par mdzad do/// / ༈ da ni de dag gi rjes gnang bya tshul la/ thog mar slob ma rnams gral du 'khod pa la/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyis khrus byas/ cha gsum bshams pa la chab bran te/ lha dang lha min gnod sbyin lto 'phye grul// sogs kyis bsngos nas bgegs bskrad/ 'og thams cad rdo rje'i sa gzhi sogs srung 'khor bsgoms nas maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug de nas rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i dgongs don gzigs pa'i rdo rje slob dpon zhig nas spyi dang bye brag gi chos bshad mdo rgyas 'tshams pas gdul bya'i rgyud snod rung du sgrub dgos par snang mod/ deng sang de 'dra dka' bas/ chos bshad kun tu 'od kyi sa'i grangs ldan las byung ba ltar sngon du btang nas/ tshig 'phro/ sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa mthar chags su 'bul ba'i dbang du btang ste/ thog mar 'phags pa dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i rgyal po la sogs pa 'ga' zhig 'bul ba la/ sgrub thabs de dag re re bzhin gang las 'byung ba'i sger brgyud 'dren tshul mi snang zhing*/

'dir spyi'i brgyud rim 'dren pa'i tshul ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ a bha yā ka ra gup+ta/ shu bha ka ra gup+ta/ pu tsa ri ka ra gup+ta/ rat+na rak+ṣi ta/ gau taṃ shrī/ kirta tsin+d+ra/ yar klung lo tsā ba grags rgyal/ bla ma rong pa sher seng*/ bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims/ thel mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ mkhan po rin chen 'phel/ gsang 'dus pa ye shes 'phel/ slob dpon kun bsod/ mkhan chen byang sems/ mkhan chen chos kyi 'od/ bla ma bsod nams bzang po/ chos rje nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ sku zhang chos rje mkhyen rab mchog grub/ 'brug pa ngag dbang chos rgyal/ rdo rje 'dzin pa chos kyi mgon po/ kun mkhyen pad+ma dkar po/ des bstan pa'i nyi ma dang lha dbang blo gros gnyis la/ de gnyis kas skyabs mgon ngag dbang rnam rgyal la/ de nas rje btsun dam chos pad dkar/ byang sems ngag dbang pad dkar/ mkhan chen shākya rin chen/ tha brag bla ma gtsug lag rgya mtsho/ 'jigs med rgyal mtshan/ shes rab rgyal mtshan/ yon tan rgyal mtshan/ des bshad sgrub 'od zer dang phrin las rgyal mtshan zung la/ de zung gis dpal ldan seṅger/ des rdo rje 'dzin pa shākya badz+ra la/ de las bdag gis zhus pa ni byin rlabs kyi rgyun ma nyams pa yin/ brgyud pa de ldan gyi gdams pa sogs/ bcom ldan 'das dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i rgyal por gsal ba'i spyan sngar snyan gsan dbab pa'i don du gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can// srid pa'i 'khor lo rnam sbyong ba// de ring bshad pa'i rin chen gter// gtso bos bdag la bka' drin stsol// ces lan gsum/ slar yang lam log pa las khyad par du gyur pa'i skyabs 'gro dang*/ lam dman pa las khyad par du gyur pa kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i byang chub sems bskyed kyi sdom pa len snyam pas rgyun bshags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi// rang gzhan don gnyis rab bsgrub phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// byung chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas// sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub bar shog/

ces lan gsum/ des skyabs sems kyi sdom pa sngar ma thob pa rnams thob cing*/ thob zin pa rnams gong 'phel du 'gro ba yin/ de nas rjes gnang dngos zhu ba'i phyir khyad par gyi gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod// rdo rje 'dzin pa dgongs su gsol// bdag gis 'gro la phan don du// gtso chen khyod la gsol 'debs kyis// ma lus bka' drin rjes gnang stsol// ces lan gsum/ de nas rjes gnang gi gzhi 'god pa la spyan dmigs 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob mar las chu 'thor zhing las sngags kyis bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ sku nyid rnams kyi phung khams skye mched kyis bsdus pa'i chos rnams mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las māṃ ljang khu sogs mngon rtogs la 'jug spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kyi cha stod du hūm̐ sngon po/ cha smad du zla ba rang gi sa bon gyis mtshan par gsal thob mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad bcom ldan 'das dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i rgyal po'i rnam par nam mkha' gang ba tsam du spyan drangs te sku nyid rnams la sib sib thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod de bstim/ slar yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od kyis dbang lha spyan drangs/ de rnams kyis rin po che'i bum pa de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi chus gang bas/ phyogs rnams nas mchod pa dang*/ bkra shis kyi glu rol mo bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pas dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ rdo rje chen pos dbang bskur ba// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyis// gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes bum pa spyi bor bkod cing khrus gsol nas bum chu sbyin/ de ltar dbang bskur ba'i chu rgyun gyis lus gang*/

ma rig pa'i dri ma bkrus/ rig pa'i ye shes bskyed nas chu rgyun gyen du rengs pa las/ rigs kyi bdag po mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ zhes brjod cing me tog 'thor/ des sku'i rjes su gnang ba song*/ de nas gsung gi rjes gnang la spyan dmigs 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob dpon dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i rgyal por gsal ba'i thugs ka nas sngags 'phreng byung ba zhal nas thon/ sku nyid rnams dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i rgyal por gsal ba'i zhal nas zhugs te snying ga'i sa bon gyi mthar 'khod pa'i mos pas sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sgrub thabs nas byung ba'i sngags rnams lan gsum rjes zlos byed du bcug cing 'phreng ba lag tu gtad/ de nas rdo rje dang bcas me tog slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag ste/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// nus pa brtan par mdzad du gsol// ces brjod/ khrom chen po yod pa ltar na me tog gtor bas 'thus/ sku nyid rnams kyis slob dpon la me tog 'thor la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyis// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// ces lan gsum/ des gsung gi rjes su gnang ba song*/ de nas thugs kyi rjes gnang la spyan dmigs 'di bzhin du mdzod/ mdun bskyed kyi tshom bu'i lha des sku nyid rnams kyi rgyud byin gyis rlobs par bzhed de so so'i spyi bor byon nas thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces maṇ+ḍal la bkod pa'i tshom bu spyi bor bzhag ste/ tshom bu'i lha spyi bor byon pa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang dang gnyis su med par gyur pa la cung zad mnyam par zhog 'tshal/ zhes mnyam par bzhag tu gzhug des thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba thob pa ste/ bcom ldan 'das dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i rgyal po sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang legs par phul grub pa lags/

slar yang thub pa rdo rje gdan gtso 'khor gsum pa'i rjes gnang 'bul ba la/ slob dpon dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i rgyal por gsal ba yongs su gyur nas/ thub pa rdo rje gdan par gsal ba'i spyan sngar/ spro na/ skyabs sems 'dzin pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs rgyun bshags rjes zlos bya/ bsdu na/ khyad par gyi gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ rdo rje 'dzin pa dgongs su gsol// zhes sogs dang*/ de nas rjes gnang gi gzhi 'god pa la spyan dmigs 'di bzhin du mdzod/ sogs nas sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang gi 'gros dam tshig gsum bkod pa bzhin la/ khyad par gyi tshig ris bsgyur kha rnams kyang rigs 'gre bar bya/ des phyi ma sgrub thabs brgya dang lnga bcu nga gcig yod pa kun kyang rigs pas 'phrul te shes par bya'o// ji tsam khyon gcig tu byas pa'i rjes ma'i mjug tu/ de ltar 'phags pa dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i rgyal po la sogs pa'i lhag pa'i lha du ma'i rjes gnang gi rim pa de tsam legs par phul grub pa yin pas/ de dag gi dus su gsungs pa'i sku gsung thugs rtsa ba yan lag gi dam tshig rnams bsrung snyam pa gyis la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi// zhes lan gsum/ de ltar rjes gnang 'bul gsan gnyis ka las byung ba'i dge rtsa ci mchis pa bstan 'gro'i don du bsngo smon lhan cig tu gnang bar zhu/ zhes bskul te/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid// sogs ji ltar 'os pa brjod nas slob ma rnams rang gnas su bkye'o// de nas slob dpon gyis rjes chog bya ste/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra puṣ+pe sogs rnam lngas mchod cing*/ srid dang ngan 'gros dub rnams la// bde dang phun tshogs kun 'byung ba// yid bzhin nor ltar rmad byung ba'i// lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod/

oṃ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya sogs yi ge brgya pas lhag chad bskang*/ ma 'byor ba dang sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ mdun bskyed kyi ye shes pa rnams oṃ khyed kyis sogs kyis gshegs gsol bya/ bdag bskyed ni/ bya rgyud spyi 'gros bzhin bsdus te rnam smin gyi lus su langs nas bsngo smon shis brjod ji ltar rigs pas mtha' brgyan par bya'o// sgrub thabs rtsa ba'i sbyar byang ni/ 'jigs med gzhung gi chu gter che mthong nas// 'jigs bral ded dpon pad dkar ma lags pa// 'jigs nas 'chad pa slar ldog gyur dogs te// 'jigs skyob phyag rgya mchog 'di bcas pa yin// rnam mang gzhung don ri mo kun gsal po// rnam dag nyung tshig bkod mar tshud pa 'di// rnam gsal bstan bcos byed pa yongs kyis su// rnam kun bsngags 'os min na gzhan pa ci// zhes so// de ltar kun mkhyen pad+ma dkar pos mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs kyi dgongs don 'khyongs pa'i sngon gyi mkhas grub rnams la khrigs bsdebs ma dgos kyang*/ da lta lnga brgya tha ma'i dus kyi rdo rje 'dzin par khas 'che ba bdag dang bdag 'dras/ de dag gi lad mo la zhugs dus lhag chad 'byung nyen che snyam bla ma brgyud pa'i gsung rgyun ji lta bar/ shākya'i dge slong yon tan 'od dam bstan 'dzin don kun grub pa'i sdes lho 'brug gi rgyud rta mgo'i ri khrod du khrigs bsdebs su bkod pa dge legs su gyur cig// /
